desc.en: Attacks all enemies, and recovers Health of all allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000074_2_1]</color>. Increases the duration of buffs on all allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000074_2_1] turn(s)</color>, and for each target damaged, increases Priority of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000074_2_3]</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、味方全体のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000074_2_1]</color>回復させる。味方全体の強化効果の持続ターンを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000074_2_1]ターン</color>増加させ、ダメージを与えた対象の数に応じて、自分の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000074_2_3]</color>UPさせる。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고, 아군 전체의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000074_2_1]</color>만큼 회복시킵니다. 아군 전체의 강화 효과 지속 시간을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000074_2_1]턴</color> 증가시키고, 피해를 준 대상마다 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000074_2_3]</color> 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并使全体友军的生命值恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000074_2_1]</color>。使全体友军的强化效果持续时间增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000074_2_1]回合</color>，每对1个目标造成伤害，自身的行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000074_2_3]</color>。

desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并使全体友军的生命值恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000074_3_3]</color>。

desc.en: Removes all buffs from all enemies and attacks. Detonates all Burned effects on the target.\nIf a target was detonated, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Instant Death</color> on all enemies.
desc.jp: 敵全体の強化効果をすべて解除し、敵全体にダメージを与える。対象の火傷をすべて破裂させる。\n1体でも破裂した場合、敵全体を<color=#28d9ed>即死</color>させる。
desc.kr: 적 전체의 강화 효과를 모두 해제하고 공격합니다. 대상의 화상을 모두 폭발시킵니다.\n한 명이라도 폭발 했다면 적 전체를 <color=#28d9ed>즉사</color> 시킵니다.
desc.zh: 解除全体敌人的所有强化效果，并进行攻击。引爆目标身上的所有烧伤效果。\n只要有一名敌人爆发，全体敌人都将<color=#28d9ed>即死</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. Inflicts an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_3_1] turn(s)</color> (Applied 2 times). This effect ignores the target's Resilience, and resets cooldown when an enemy is defeated.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。対象に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>2個を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。この効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。敵を倒した場合、スキルターンが初期化する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_3_1]턴</color> 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color> 상태로 만듭니다. (2회 적용) 이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시하며, 적 처치 시 쿨타임이 초기화됩니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。对目标造成无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_3_1]回合</color>(可叠加2次)。该效果无视目标的效果抵抗，且击杀敌人时冷却时间重置。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\nAt the start of battle, grants an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>reduced damage taken</color> effect to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s)</color>.\nAfter using <color=#28d9ed>Ballad of a Soldier</color> / <color=#28d9ed>Apocalypse Now</color>, when a target hit is not inflicted with Burned, recovers Weakness Gauge by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_2]</color>, and inflicts an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on a random ally for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_3] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n戦闘開始時、自分に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>ダメージDOWN</color>効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]ターン</color>の間付与する。\n<color=#28d9ed>【兵士の詩】</color>/<color=#28d9ed>【地獄の黙示録】</color>使用後、ダメージを受けた対象が火傷状態でない場合、WGを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_2]</color>回復し、ランダムな味方単体に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n전투 시작 시 자신에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>피해 감소</color> 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>병사의 시</color> / <color=#28d9ed>지옥의 묵시록</color> 사용 후 피격 대상 중 화상 상태가 아닌 적이 한 명이라도 있다면 WG를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_2]</color> 회복하고, 무작위 아군 한 명을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_3]턴</color> 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color> 상태로 만듭니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)\n战斗开始时，自身获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>伤害降低</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]回合</color>。\n使用<color=#28d9ed>战士之诗</color> / <color=#28d9ed>地狱启示录</color>后，受击目标中只要存在1名未处于烧伤状态的敌人，则WG恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_2]</color>，并对随机1名友军造成无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_3]回合</color>。

desc.jp: 敵2体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_1_1]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_1_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 적 2인을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_1_1]</color> 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_1_1]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击2名敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_1_1]</color>的几率使目标的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_1_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks 2 enemies, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]</color> chance to remove <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>buff(s)</color> from the target.\nIf the target is Earth element, inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵2体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]個</color>解除する。\n対象が地属性の場合、<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 적 2인을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]</color>의 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]개</color> 해제합니다.\n대상이 지속성이라면 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击2名敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]</color>的几率解除目标的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_2_1]个</color><color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>。\n若目标为土属性，则<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks 2 enemies, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color> chance to inflict reduced <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1] turn(s)</color>.\nAdditionally, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unhealable</color> on Earth targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵2体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>の確率で敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。\nまた、対象が地属性の場合、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>回復不可</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 적 2인을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]턴</color> 동안 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 감소시킵니다.\n추가로 지속성 대상에게는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>회복 불가</color>를 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击2名敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>的几率使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>和<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]回合</color>。\n并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>的几率对土属性目标造成<color=#28d9ed>无法恢复</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color> chance to grant increased <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>の確率で自分の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。
desc.kr: 적 대상을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color> 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击目标敌人，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>的几率提升自身的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: Removes <color=#28d9ed>all</color> debuffs from the caster and grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2] turn(s)</color>, then attacks an enemy.
desc.jp: 自分の弱体効果を<color=#28d9ed>すべて</color>解除し、<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>UP効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2]ターン</color>の間付与した後、敵単体にダメージを与える。
desc.kr: 자신에게 걸려 있는 약화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 제거하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color> 증가 효과를 부여한 뒤 적 대상을 공격합니다.
desc.zh: 解除自身附带的<color=#28d9ed>所有</color>弱化效果，并获得<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提升效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2]回合</color>后，攻击敌人目标。

name.jp: レクイエム・セルケト

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. Enemies killed by this skill cannot be Resurrected or Revived.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。このスキルで倒れた敵は復活と蘇生ができなくなる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. 이 스킬로 사망한 적은 부활 및 소생이 불가능합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。因该技能死亡的敌人无法触发复活与苏醒效果。

name.en: Scorpion Tail's One Hit, One Kill

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
At the start of battle, grants a permanent irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Stealth</color> to the caster.
At the start of the turn, grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Critical Damage</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2] turn(s)</color>, and if the hit was non-critical, recovers Weakness Gauge by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_4]</color>.
Increases damage dealt by all attacks of the caster proportional to the caster's and target's Speed.
Every turn, increases Attack of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>. (Max 20 stacks)
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
戦闘開始時、自分に<color=#28d9ed>隠れ身</color>を永続的に付与する。この効果は解除されない。
ターン開始時、<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>と<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]ターン</color>の間UPさせ、攻撃時に会心が発生しなかった場合、WGを[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_4]回復する。
自分のすべての攻撃は、自分と対象のスピードが高いほどダメージがUPする。
毎ターン自分の攻撃力が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>UPする。(最大20回まで累積)
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
전투 입장 시 자신에게 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>은신</color> 효과를 영구적으로 부여합니다.
턴 시작 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]턴</color> 동안 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color> 및 <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해</color>가 증가하며, 치명 공격이 발생하지 않았다면 WG를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_4]</color> 회복합니다.
자신의 모든 공격은 자신과 대상의 속도에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.
매 턴 자신의 공격력이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>증가 합니다. (최대 20회 누적)
desc.zh:
(被动效果)
进入战斗时，使自身获得无法被解除的永久<color=#28d9ed>隐身</color>效果。
回合开始时，自身的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>和<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]回合</color>，暴击未触发时，WG恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_4]</color>。
自身的所有攻击根据自身和目标的速度等比提升伤害。
每回合自身的攻击力提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>。(最多可叠加20次)

name.jp: ニンジャのバラエティコンボ

desc.en: Attacks an enemy, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000072_1_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unbuffable</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000072_1_1] turn(s)</color>.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000072_1_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>強化不可</color>を[Buff_T_2000072_1_1]ターンの間付与する。\nこのスキルは自分の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000072_1_1]</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>강화 불가</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000072_1_1]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.\n이 스킬은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000072_1_1]</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>无法强化</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000072_1_1]回合</color>。\n该技能根据自身<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>等比提升伤害。

desc.en: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants <color=#28d9ed>A Ninja's Afterimage</color> to the caster.\n(Triggered Effect) When an ally is inflicted with a debuff, activates an <color=#28d9ed>Agile Response</color>.\nRemoves 1 <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color> from all allies, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000072_2_6]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unhealable</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000072_2_6] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)戦闘開始時、自分に<color=#28d9ed>【ニンジャの残像】</color>を付与する。\n(発動効果)味方に弱体効果がある場合、<color=#28d9ed>【迅速対応】</color>が発動する。\n【迅速対応】：味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を1個解除し、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000072_2_6]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>回復不可</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000072_2_6]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)전투 시작 시, 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>닌자의 잔상</color>을 부여합니다. \n(발동 효과)아군에게 약화 효과 적용 시 <color=#28d9ed>신속 대응</color> 효과가 발동합니다.\n아군 전체 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 1개 해제하고, 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000072_2_6]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000072_2_6]턴</color>동안 <color=#28d9ed>회복불가</color>를 부여합니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)战斗开始时，使自身获得<color=#28d9ed>忍者的残像</color>效果。\n(触发效果)友军附带弱化效果时，触发<color=#28d9ed>迅速应对</color>\n效果。解除全体友军的1个<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000072_2_6]</color>的几率对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>无法恢复</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000072_2_6]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. This skill ignores <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of the target's Defense.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。このスキルは対象の防御力を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>無視する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 이 스킬은 대상의 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 무시합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。该技能无视目标防御力的<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。

desc.en:
Attacks an enemy.
Depending on the unique effect applied to the caster, activates one of the following effects:

Ume Ichirin: Attacks an enemy. After attacking, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_1_1]</color> chance to increase <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_1_1]</color>.

Sakura, Chiru: Attacks all enemies. Always attacks with <color=#28d9ed>elemental advantage</color>.
desc.jp:
敵単体にダメージを与える。
自分に【梅一輪】または【桜散る】がある場合、次の効果が発動する。

【梅一輪】：敵単体にダメージを与える。攻撃後<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_1_1]</color>の確率で自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_1_1]</color>UPさせる。

 【桜散る】：敵全体にダメージを与える。このスキルは敵の属性を無視し、<color=#28d9ed>有利属性</color>の攻撃判定でダメージを与える。
desc.kr:
적을 공격합니다.
보유한 고유 효과에 따라 이하의 효과 중 하나가 적용됩니다.

【우메이치린】 : 적을 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_1_1]</color>의 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_1_1]</color> 증가시킵니다.

【사쿠라치루】 : 적 전체를 공격합니다. 항상 <color=#28d9ed>유리한 상성</color>으로 적용됩니다.
desc.zh:
攻击敌人。
根据附带的固有效果触发以下效果之一。

【一朵梅花】：攻击敌人。攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_1_1]</color>的几率使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_1_1]</color>。

【樱花凋零】：攻击全体敌人。总是以<color=#28d9ed>优势属性</color>施展。

desc.en:
Attacks an enemy, then grants an extra turn.

Before attacking, if the target's Health is less than or equal to <color=#28d9ed>90%</color>, grants the <color=#28d9ed>Ume Ichirin</color> effect for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_3_1] turn(s)</color>, and increases damage dealt.

If the target's Health is greater than <color=#28d9ed>90%</color>, grants the <color=#28d9ed>Sakura, Chiru</color> effect for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_3_2] turn(s)</color>, and reduces <color=#28d9ed>Chain Points</color> by <color=#28d9ed>15</color>.
desc.jp:
敵単体にダメージを与え、追加ターンを獲得する。

攻撃前に対象の残りHPが<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>以下の場合、自分に<color=#28d9ed>【梅一輪】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与し、与えるダメージがUPする。

対象の残りHPが<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>を超える場合、自分に<color=#28d9ed>【桜散る】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与し、<color=#28d9ed>CP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>15</color>DOWNさせる。
desc.kr:
적을 공격 후 추가 턴을 획득합니다.

공격 전 대상의 현재 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>90%</color> 이하라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_3_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>우메이치린</color> 효과를 획득하고, 피해량이 증가합니다.

대상의 현재 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>90%</color>를 초과한다면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_3_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>사쿠라치루</color> 효과를 획득하고, <color=#28d9ed>CP</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>15</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh:
攻击敌人后获得额外回合。

攻击前，若目标的当前生命值在<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>以下，则获得<color=#28d9ed>一朵梅花</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_3_1]回合</color>，并使伤害量提升。

若目标的当前生命值高于<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>，则获得<color=#28d9ed>樱花凋零</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_3_2]回合</color>，且<color=#28d9ed>CP</color>减少<color=#28d9ed>15</color>点。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
Always grants <color=#28d9ed>Buff Enhancement</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Debuff Enhancement</color> to the caster. This effect is irremovable.
At the start of the turn, grants a <color=#28d9ed>random increased stat effect</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_2_1] turn(s)</color>, and recovers Weakness Gauge by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_1]</color>.
Every turn, increases Attack of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>. (Max 20 stacks)
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
自分に<color=#28d9ed>強化促進</color>と<color=#28d9ed>弱体促進</color>を付与する。この効果は解除されない。
ターン開始時、自分に<color=#28d9ed>ランダムなステータスUP効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_2_1]ターン</color>の間付与し、WGを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_1]</color>回復する。
毎ターン自分の攻撃力が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>UPする。(最大20回まで累積)
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
자신은 항상 <color=#28d9ed>강화 촉진</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>약화 촉진</color>을 얻습니다. 이 효과는 해제되지 않습니다.
턴 시작 시 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_2_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>무작위 능력치 증가 효과</color>를 부여하며, WG를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_1]</color> 회복합니다.
매 턴 자신의 공격력이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>증가 합니다. (최대 20회 누적)
desc.zh:
(被动效果)
自身始终获得<color=#28d9ed>强化促进</color>和<color=#28d9ed>弱化促进</color>效果。该效果不会被解除。
回合开始时，使自身获得<color=#28d9ed>随机能力值提升效果</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_2_1]回合</color>，WG恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000065_4_1]</color>。
每回合自身的攻击力提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup]</color>。(最多可叠加20次)

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000019_1_1]</color>. Increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000019_1_3]</color> if the target was a Fire enemy.

desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000019_1_1]</color> 증가시킵니다. 대상이 화속성이라면 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000019_1_3]</color> 증가시킵니다.

desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。\n此技能始终视为<color=#28d9ed>属性克制</color>，且在拥有增益时会重置冷却。\n每次使用<color=#28d9ed>罗刹斩</color>，自身<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>7%</color>（最多叠加5次）。

(Max 5 stacks)

Additionally, increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> and grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Buff Enhancement</color> for 1 turn.\nTakes Weakness Gauge damage only when hit by a counterattack.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n戦闘開始時、味方全体に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>ダメージDOWN</color>効果を3ターンの間付与する。また、自分は<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>UPし、自分に<color=#28d9ed>会心率UP</color>、<color=#28d9ed>強化促進</color>を1ターンの間付与する。\n反撃のダメージでのみWGダメージを受ける。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n전투 시작 시 아군 전체에게 3턴 동안 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>피해 감소</color>를 부여합니다. 추가로 자신은 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 증가하고, 1턴 동안 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>증가 ,<color=#28d9ed>강화 촉진</color> 효과를 부여합니다.\n반격으로 피격 시에만 WG 피해를 받습니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)\n战斗开始时，全体友军获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>伤害降低</color>效果，持续3回合。自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>额外提升<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>，并获得<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升、<color=#28d9ed>强化促进</color>效果，持续1回合。\n仅在受到反击时，受到WG伤害。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000066_1_1]</color> chance to reduce the cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>The Culprit is You!</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_1_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000066_1_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>【犯人はあなたです!】</color>のスキルターンを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_1_1]ターン</color>減少させる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000066_1_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>범인은 바로 당신!</color> 스킬의 쿨타임을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_1_1]턴</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000066_1_1]</color>的几率使<color=#28d9ed>犯人就是你！</color>的技能冷却时间减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_1_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: (Triggered Effect) When an ally uses an attack that targets all enemies, grants increased Attack to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2] turn(s)</color>, and increases Priority of ally Mages by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3]</color>.
desc.jp: (発動効果)味方が全体攻撃時、味方全体の攻撃力を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2]ターン</color>の間UPさせ、魔法型の味方の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3]</color>UPさせる。
desc.kr: (발동 효과) 아군이 전체 공격을 했을 때, 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2]턴</color>동안 공격력을 증가시키고, 아군의 마법형 캐릭터는 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3]</color> 증가합니다.
desc.zh: (触发效果)友军发动全体攻击时，使全体友军攻击力提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2]回合</color>，并使友军中魔法型角色的行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3]</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies without <color=#28d9ed>missing</color>, and grants increased Critical Damage and Critical Hit Chance to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000066_3_2] turn(s)</color>. After using the skill, reduces the cooldown of the <color=#28d9ed>Thinking Time</color> skill by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_3_1]</color> turns.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、味方全体の命中と会心率を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000066_3_2]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。このスキルは<color=#28d9ed>ミスヒット</color>が発生しない。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고, 아군 전체는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000066_3_2]턴</color> 동안 치명 피해 및 치명 확률이 증가합니다.\n스킬 사용 후 <color=#28d9ed>씽킹 타임</color> 스킬의 쿨타임을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_3_1]턴</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，不会发生<color=#28d9ed>闪避</color>，并使全体友军的命中和暴击率提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000066_3_2]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color>.\nIf the caster has <color=#28d9ed>Fierce Offensive</color>, the effect is applied to <color=#28d9ed>all allies</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color>UPさせる。\n<color=#28d9ed>【アースエッジ】</color>がある場合、<color=#28d9ed>味方全体</color>の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>をUPさせる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color> 증가시킵니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>매서운 공세</color> 보유 시 <color=#28d9ed>아군 전체</color>에게 효과가 적용됩니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color>。\n附带<color=#28d9ed>猛烈攻势</color>效果时，将对<color=#28d9ed>全体友军</color>生效。

desc.en:
(Triggered Effect) Activates <color=#28d9ed>Crystal Storm</color> when an ally lands a debuff on their turn.

<color=#28d9ed>Crystal Storm</color>: Attacks all enemies, and inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
If the caster has <color=#28d9ed>Fierce Offensive</color>, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2] turn(s)</color>. If the target is a <color=#28d9ed>Healer</color>, additionally inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Silenced</color>.
desc.jp:
(発動効果)味方が自分のターンで敵に弱体効果を付与した場合、<color=#28d9ed>【大地の烈斬】</color>を使用する。

<color=#28d9ed>【大地の烈斬】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与え、対象の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
<color=#28d9ed>【アースエッジ】</color>がある場合、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。対象が<color=#28d9ed>回復型</color>の場合、追加で<color=#28d9ed>沈黙</color>を付与する。
desc.kr:
(발동 효과) 아군 팀이 자신의 턴에 적에게 약화 효과 적중 시 <color=#28d9ed>결정 쇄도</color>를 사용합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>결정 쇄도</color> : 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]턴</color> 동안 대상 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 감소시킵니다.
<color=#28d9ed>매서운 공세</color> 보유 시 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다. 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>회복형</color>이라면 추가적으로 <color=#28d9ed>침묵</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh:
(触发效果)友军在自身回合对敌人造成弱化效果时，使用<color=#28d9ed>晶体风暴</color>。

<color=#28d9ed>晶体风暴</color>：攻击全体敌人，并使全体目标的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]回合</color>。
附带<color=#28d9ed>猛烈攻势</color>效果时，对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]回合</color>。若目标为<color=#28d9ed>恢复型</color>，则额外造成<color=#28d9ed>沉默</color>效果。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. After attacking, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color>, and grants <color=#28d9ed>Fierce Offensive</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color>UPさせ、<color=#28d9ed>【アースエッジ】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1]ターン</color>の間獲得する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color> 증가시키고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>매서운 공세</color>를 획득합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color>，并获得<color=#28d9ed>猛烈攻势</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. When attacking while granted a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color>, increases Priority of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000071_1_2]</color>. Damage dealt increases proportional to <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> instead of Attack.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>状態で攻撃時、自分の行動ゲージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000071_1_2]</color>UPする。このスキルは攻撃力の代わりに<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적 대상을 공격합니다. <color=#28d9ed>실드</color> 보유 중 공격 시 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000071_1_2]</color> 증가합니다. 이 스킬은 공격력 대신 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人目标。附带<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>攻击时，使自身行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000071_1_2]</color>。该技能根据<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>而非攻击力等比提升伤害。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect) When hit by an attack that targets all enemies, grants a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000071_2_5] turn(s)</color>.

(Triggered Effect) When an ally scores or takes a critical hit, activates <color=#28d9ed>Are You Strong?!</color> on the <color=#28d9ed>enemy with the highest Attack</color>.
Damage dealt increases proportional to Defense instead of Attack. Recovers Health and increases Priority of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000071_2_2]</color>.
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)全体攻撃でダメージを受けるたびに、自分に<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000071_2_5]ターン</color>の間付与する。

(発動効果)味方が敵を攻撃時、会心が発生した場合、もしくは敵から会心ダメージを受けた場合<color=#28d9ed>最も攻撃力が高い敵</color>に<color=#28d9ed>【強えぇヤツか!】</color>を使用する。
攻撃力の代わりに防御力が高いほどダメージがUPし、自分のHPと行動ゲージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000071_2_2]</color>回復する。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과) 전체 공격으로 피격 될 때 마다 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000071_2_5]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.

(발동 효과) 아군이 치명 공격을 하거나 당할 시 <color=#28d9ed>공격력이 가장 높은 적</color>에게 <color=#28d9ed>센 녀석이냐!</color>를 사용합니다.
공격력 대신 방어력에 비례하여 피해가 증가하며, 자신의 체력 및 행동게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000071_2_2]</color> 회복합니다.
desc.zh:
(被动效果)每当受到全体攻击时，使自身获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000071_2_5]回合</color>。

(触发效果)友军发动暴击或受到暴击时，对<color=#28d9ed>攻击力最高的敌人</color>发动<color=#28d9ed>厉害的家伙！</color>。
根据防御力而非攻击力等比提升伤害，且使自身生命值和行动值恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000071_2_2]</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy, and grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000071_3_1] turn(s)</color>. When an enemy is defeated, <color=#28d9ed>resets</color> the skill cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>Are You Strong?!</color>.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> instead of Attack and additionally increases proportional to missing Health.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000071_3_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。敵を倒した時、<color=#28d9ed>【強えぇヤツか!】</color>のスキルターンが<color=#28d9ed>初期化</color>される。\nこのスキルは攻撃力の代わりに<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>が高いほどダメージがUPし、残りHPが低いほどダメージが追加でUPする。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000071_3_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다. 적 처치 시 <color=#28d9ed>센 녀석이냐!</color>의 스킬 쿨타임이 <color=#28d9ed>초기화</color> 됩니다.\n이 스킬은 공격력 대신 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>에 비례하여 피해가 증가하며, 잃은 체력에 비례하여 피해가 추가로 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并使自身<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000071_3_1]回合</color>。击杀敌人时，<color=#28d9ed>厉害的家伙！</color>技能冷却时间<color=#28d9ed>重置</color>。\n该技能根据<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>而非攻击力等比提升伤害，且根据损失生命值等比提升额外伤害量。

desc.en: Attacks 2 enemies with Heavy Strike.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color>\nand deals more damage to bosses.
desc.jp: 敵2体に強撃でダメージを与える。\n自分の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどダメージがUPし、\nボスにはより大きなダメージを与える。
desc.kr: 적 2인을 강격으로 공격합니다.\n자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가하고\n보스에게는 더 큰 피해를 입힙니다.
desc.zh: 攻击2名敌人造成强击伤害。\n自身<color=#28d9ed>最大生命值</color>越高伤害越高，\n对首领造成更高伤害。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies, and recovers Health of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000008_2_2]</color>.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color> and additionally increases inversely proportional to the number of targets.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、自分のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000008_2_2]</color>回復する。\n自分の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどダメージがUPし、対象の数が少ないほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 자신의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000008_2_2]</color> 회복합니다.\n자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다. 대상의 수가 적을수록 피해가 추가로 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并使自身生命值恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000008_2_2]</color>。\n自身<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>越高，则该技能的伤害越高；目标数量越少，则该技能的额外伤害越高。

name.jp: エンド・オブ・ワールド

desc.en: Reduces <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000008_3_3] turn(s)</color> (Ignores Resilience) before attacking all enemies with Heavy Strike.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color> and additionally increases inversely proportional to the number of targets.\nDeals more damage to bosses and gains an <color=#28d9ed>extra turn</color>.
desc.jp: スキル発動前に対象全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000008_3_3]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせ(効果抵抗無視)、敵全体に強撃でダメージを与える。\n自分の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどダメージがUPし、対象が少ないほどダメージが追加でUPする。\nボスにはより大きなダメージを与え、自分には<color=#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。
desc.kr: 스킬 사용 전 대상 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000008_3_3]턴</color> 동안 감소시키고(효과 저항 무시) 적 전체를 강격으로 공격합니다.\n자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가하며 대상이 적을수록 피해가 추가로 증가합니다.\n보스에게는 더 큰 피해를 입히고 자신은 <color=#28d9ed>추가 턴</color>을 얻습니다.
desc.zh: 在技能发动前，使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000008_3_3]</color>回合（无视效果抵抗），然后以强击攻击全体敌人。\n自身<color=#28d9ed>最大生命值</color>越高伤害越高，目标越少伤害越大。\n对Boss造成更高伤害，自身获得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s)</color>.
Applies <color=#28d9ed>Heavy Strike</color> to all attacks of the caster.

desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并使全体友军获得<color=#28d9ed>吸血</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_2_3]回合</color>。

desc.en: Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_1]</color> chance each to grant increased <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_1] turn(s)</color>, then attacks all enemies.\nAfter attacking, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_2]</color> chance to grant <color=#28d9ed>Immortality</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_2] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: それぞれ<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_1]</color>の確率で味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>命中</color>と<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせた後、敵全体にダメージを与える。\n攻撃後、自分に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>不死</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킨 후 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_2]턴</color> 동안 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>불사</color>를 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 全体友军各有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_1]</color>的几率获得<color=#28d9ed>命中</color>和<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_1]回合</color>，随后攻击全体敌人。\n攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_2]</color>的几率使自身获得<color=#28d9ed>不死</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_3_2]回合</color>。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s)</color>.
After using an attack that targets all enemies, all Doppelgängers activate an additional attack against the enemy with the highest Attack.
When a Doppelgänger is killed, increases Priority and Attack of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_doppelganger_2_2]</color>. (Max 20 stacks for Attack)
At the start of the turn, when the caster is granted a buff, recovers Weakness Gauge by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_4_1]</color>. Additionally, when all allies except for the caster have been killed, increases all skill cooldowns of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
戦闘開始時、自分に解除不可能なダメージDOWN効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]ターン</color>の間付与する。
全体攻撃後、すべての【自己像幻視】は攻撃力が最も高い敵単体に追加攻撃を与える。
【自己像幻視】が倒れた時、自分の行動ゲージと攻撃力が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_doppelganger_2_2]</color>UPする。(攻撃力は最大20回まで累積)
ターン開始時、自分に強化効果がある場合、WGを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_4_1]</color>回復する。自分を除く味方全体が倒れた状態の場合、自分のすべてのスキルのスキルターンを<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>増加させる。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
전투 시작 시 자신에게 해제되지 않는 피해 감소 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.
전체 공격 이후 모든 도플갱어들은 공격력이 가장 높은 적에게 추가 공격을 합니다.
도플갱어가 사망했을 때 자신의 행동 게이지와 공격력이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_doppelganger_2_2]</color> 증가합니다. (공격력은 최대 20회 누적)
턴 시작 시 자신이 강화 효과를 보유하고 있다면 WG를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_4_1]</color> 회복합니다. 또한 자신을 제외 한 아군이 모두 사망한 상태라면 자신의 모든 스킬 쿨타임이 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 증가합니다.
desc.zh:
(被动效果)
战斗开始时，使自身获得无法被解除的伤害降低效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]回合</color>。
全体攻击后，所有二重身对攻击力最高的敌人发动额外攻击。
二重身死亡时，自身的行动值和攻击力提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_doppelganger_2_2]</color>。(攻击力最多可叠加20次)
回合开始时，若自身附带强化效果，则WG恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_4_1]</color>。另外，若除自身外的友军全部死亡，自身的所有技能冷却时间增加<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect) Upon death, increases Priority and Attack of Mero by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_doppelganger_2_2]</color>.\n(Triggered Effect) When an ally uses an attack that targets all enemies, activates an additional attack against the enemy with the highest Attack.

desc.kr: (패시브 효과) 사망했을 때 메로의 행동 게이지와 공격력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_doppelganger_2_2]</color> 증가 시킵니다.\n(발동 효과) 아군이 전체 공격을 했을 때 공격력이 가장 높은 적에게 추가 공격을 합니다.

desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_1_2]</color> chance to inflict reduced <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_1_2] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_1_2]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_1_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_1_2]</color>의 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_1_2]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_1_2]</color>的几率使目标的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_1_2]回合</color>。

desc.en: When an ally is hit, counterattacks with <color=#28d9ed>Nirvana's Inferno</color>.\n(Triggered Effect) Before attacking, removes <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_2_2_1]</color> buff(s) from the target, and inflicts reduced Resilience for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_2_4_1] turn(s)</color>. If the target is <color=#28d9ed>Earth element</color>, ignores the target's Resilience, and does not miss.
desc.jp: 味方がダメージを受けた時、<color=#28d9ed>【彼岸劫火】</color>で反撃する。\n(パッシブ効果)攻撃前、対象に強化効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_2_2_1]個</color>解除し、回避を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_2_4_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。対象が<color=#28d9ed>地属性</color>の場合、対象の効果抵抗を無視し、ミスヒットが発生しない。
desc.kr: 아군이 피격 시 <color=#28d9ed>피안의 겁화</color>로 반격합니다.\n(발동 효과) 공격 전 대상의 강화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_2_2_1]개</color> 해제하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_2_4_1]턴</color> 동안 효과 저항을 감소시킵니다. 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>지속성</color>이라면 대상의 효과 저항을 무시하고, 빗나감이 발생하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 友军受到攻击时，用<color=#28d9ed>血液轮回</color>反击。\n(触发效果)攻击前解除目标的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_2_2_1]个</color>强化效果，并使回避降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_2_4_1]回合</color>。若目标为<color=#28d9ed>土属性</color>，则无视目标的效果抵抗，且不会触发闪避。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. Ignores Resilience and Immunity to increase <color=#28d9ed>skill cooldowns</color> of all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>, and grants <color=#28d9ed>Sustained Recovery</color> to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_3_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。敵全体の効果抵抗および免疫を無視し、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>スキルターン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>増加させ、味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>継続回復</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 적 전체에게 효과 저항 및 면역을 무시하고 <color=#28d9ed>스킬 쿨타임</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 증가시키고, 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_3_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>지속 회복</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。无视全体敌人的效果抵抗和免疫，使其<color=#28d9ed>技能冷却时间</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>，并使全体友军获得<color=#28d9ed>持续恢复</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_3_1]回合</color>。

战斗开始时，自身获得无法被解除的伤害降低效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]回合</color>，<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。
力竭之前，对全体敌人造成无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>沉默</color>状态。
除爆发技能、夹攻、连携技能外的技能造成的WG伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4086001_4_13]</color>。
敌人行动时，自身附带弱化效果时，自身的行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000075_4_2]</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies.\nIf it is the caster's turn, obtains <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_1_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>Desire to Dominate (Unique Resource)</color>.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color> and deals greater damage to Bosses.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。\n自分のターンの場合、<color=#28d9ed>【固有資源：支配欲】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_1_1]個</color>獲得する。\nこのスキルは自分の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほど与えるダメージがUPし、ボスの場合、より大ダメージを与える。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n자신의 턴이라면 <color=#28d9ed>고유 자원 : 지배욕</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_1_1]개</color> 획득합니다.\n이 스킬은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가하고, 보스에게는 더 큰 피해를 입힙니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。\n若处于自身回合，则获得<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_1_1]个</color><color=#28d9ed>固有资源：统治欲</color>效果。\n自身的<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>越高，则该技能的伤害越高，对首领造成的伤害也越高。

desc.en: (Triggered Effect) Prepares <color=#28d9ed>Revenge</color> effect for every <color=#28d9ed>cooldown cycle</color> of this skill.\nWhen <color=#28d9ed>Revenge</color> is activated, attacks all enemies, and reduces all skill cooldowns of all allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_2_4] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: (発動効果)<color=#28d9ed>スキルターン</color>ごとに<color=#28d9ed>【復讐】</color>を発動する。\n<color=#28d9ed>【復讐】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与え、味方全体のすべてのスキルターンを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_2_4]ターン</color>減少させる。
desc.kr: (발동 효과) 스킬의 <color=#28d9ed>쿨타임</color>마다 <color=#28d9ed>복수</color> 효과를 준비합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>복수</color> 발동 시 적 전체를 공격하고 아군 전체의 모든 스킬 쿨타임이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_2_4]턴</color> 감소합니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)每个技能的<color=#28d9ed>冷却时间</color>准备<color=#28d9ed>复仇</color>效果。\n<color=#28d9ed>复仇</color>发动时，攻击全体敌人，使全体友军的所有技能冷却时间减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_2_4]回合</color>。

name.jp: ワールド・イズ・マイン

desc.en: <color=#28d9ed>Requires [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_3_1] Desire to Dominate (Unique Resource) to use this skill.</color>\nAttacks all enemies, and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Petrified</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_3_3] turn(s)</color>. The Petrified effect ignores the target's Resilience.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color>.
desc.jp: このスキルは<color=#28d9ed>【固有資源：支配欲】が[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_3_1]個ある場合、使用できる。</color>\n敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_3_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。石化は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。\nこのスキルは自分の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: <color=#28d9ed>고유 자원 : 지배욕 [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_3_1]개 보유 시 사용 가능합니다.</color>\n적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_3_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>석화</color>를 부여합니다. 석화 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.\n이 스킬은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: <color=#28d9ed>持有[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_3_1]个固有资源：统治欲时可以使用。</color>\n攻击全体敌人，并造成<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_3_3]回合</color>。石化效果无视目标的效果抵抗。\n自身的<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>越高，则该技能的伤害越高。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s)</color>.
When an enemy performs an action, if the caster's Health is less than or equal to <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>, Demiurge Astei <color=#28d9ed>counterattacks</color>, and if the caster's Health is greater than <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>, grants a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> to Demiurge Astei for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_4_3] turn(s)</color>.
When not <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>, reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by  <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500043_4_2]</color>.
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
戦闘開始時、自分に解除不可能なダメージDOWN効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]ターン</color>の間付与する。
敵が行動時、自分のHPが<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>以下の場合、【デミウルゴス・アステ】が代わりに<color=#28d9ed>【反撃】</color>を発動し、自分のHPが<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>を超える場合、【デミウルゴス・アステ】に<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_4_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。
<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態でない場合、受けるWGダメージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500043_4_2]</color>DOWNさせる。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
전투 시작 시 자신에게 해제되지 않는 피해 감소 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.
적 행동 시 자신의 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 이하라면 데미우르고스 아스테가 <color=#28d9ed>반격</color>하며, 자신의 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 초과한다면 데미우르고스 아스테에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_4_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 부여합니다.
<color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태가 아니라면 받는 WG 피해량을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500043_4_2]</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh:
(被动效果)
战斗开始时，自身获得无法被解除的伤害降低效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single]回合</color>。
敌人行动时，若自身生命值在<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>以下，创世之神·奥斯黛将进行<color=#28d9ed>反击</color>，当自身生命值超过<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>时，创世之神·奥斯黛获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_4_3]回合</color>。
若未处于<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，则受到的WG伤害量降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500043_4_2]</color>。

desc.en: (Triggered Effect) Upon death, immediately <color=#28d9ed>resurrects</color> and recovers Health by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_1]</color>.\nUpon resurrection, grants <color=#28d9ed>Doll Garden's Caretaker</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_5] turn(s)</color>, and if Demiurge Stella's Health is greater than 30%, resets skill cooldowns of the caster. Additionally, increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_4]</color>.
desc.jp: (発動効果)倒れた時、直ちにHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_1]</color>回復して<color=#28d9ed>復活</color>する。\n復活時、自分に<color=#28d9ed>【箱庭の主】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_5]ターン</color>の間付与し、【デミウルゴス・ステラ】のHPが30%を超える場合、自分のスキルターンを初期化する。また、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_4]</color>UPさせる。
desc.kr: (발동 효과) 사망 시 즉시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_1]</color>의 체력을 회복하며 <color=#28d9ed>부활</color>합니다. \n부활 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_5]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>모형 정원의 관리자</color>를 획득하고, 데미우르고스 스텔라의 체력이 30%를 초과한다면 자신의 스킬 쿨타임이 초기화 됩니다. 추가로 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_4]</color> 증가합니다.
desc.zh: (触发效果)死亡时，立即恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_1]</color>生命值并<color=#28d9ed>复活</color>。\n复活时，获得<color=#28d9ed>模型庄园的管理者</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_5]回合</color>，创世之神·斯黛拉的生命值超出30%时，则自身技能冷却时间重置。另外<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000059_2_4]</color>。

desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。このスキルは対象の防御力を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>貫通し、対象の数が少ないほど与えるダメージがUPする。\nこのスキルは倒れた敵の数に応じて、与えるダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 이 스킬은 대상의 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 무시하며, 대상의 수가 적을수록 피해가 증가합니다.\n이 스킬의 피해량은 사망자가 발생할 때마다 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。该技能无视目标<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的防御力，目标数量越少，则该技能的伤害越高。\n每次出现死亡者时，该技能的伤害量都会提升。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
Greatly reduces damage taken by the Boss.
Weakness Gauge can be <color=#28d9ed>reduced</color> only <color=#28d9ed>when hit</color> if all surviving allies are inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color>.
If an ally is inflicted with a debuff when hit, reduces Priority of all allies by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>. (Only once per turn)

(パッシブ効果)
戦闘開始時、<color=#28d9ed>防衛システム：シグマドーム</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間付与する。
味方・敵が行動した後、<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>状態でない味方がいる場合、<color=#28d9ed>防衛システム：シグマドーム</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間付与する。
味方が弱体効果ダメージを受けた場合、味方全体の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>DOWNさせる。(1ターンに1回のみ)
ボスとイプシロンはターン開始時、自分の弱体効果をすべて解除する。
ボスが<color=#28d9ed>ブレイク</color>した後、<color=#28d9ed>防衛システム：シグマドーム</color>は付与できない。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
전투 입장 시 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>방어 시스템 : 시그마 돔</color>을 생성합니다.
아군과 적이 행동 후, <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 보유하지 않은 아군이 있다면 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>방어 시스템 : 시그마 돔</color>이 생성 됩니다.
아군이 약화효과 피해 시 아군 전체의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소 합니다.(1턴 당 1회 가능)
보스와 엡실론은 턴 시작 시 자신의 약화효과를 모두 해제합니다.
보스 <color=#28d9ed>브레이크</color>이후 <color=#28d9ed>방어 시스템 : 시그마 돔</color>은 생성되지 않습니다.
desc.zh:
(被动效果)
大幅降低首领受到的伤害。
所有幸存的友军只在处于<color=#28d9ed>触电</color>状态的情况下<color=#28d9ed>受到攻击时</color>，WG才会<color=#28d9ed>降低</color>。
友军受到弱化效果伤害时，全体友军的行动值降低<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>(1回合仅限1次)。
首领和埃普西隆在回合开始时均解除自身的所有弱化效果。
首领<color=#28d9ed>力竭</color>时受到的<color=#28d9ed>伤害降低</color>和<color=#28d9ed>WG降低免疫</color>效果会被解除。

name.jp: スーパー殺戮マシーン

desc.en: Attacks 2 enemies, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_1_1]</color> chance to grant increased <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000070_1_1] turn(s)</color>.\n\nDamage dealt increases when the target is granted a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color>.
desc.jp: 敵2体にダメージを与える。<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_1_1]</color>の確率で自分の<color=#28d9ed>命中</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000070_1_1]ターン</color>の間UPする。\n\nこのスキルは対象が<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>状態の場合、ダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적 2인을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_1_1]</color> 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000070_1_1]턴</color> 동안 증가합니다.\n\n이 스킬은 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 보유하고 있을 때 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击2名敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_1_1]</color>的几率使自身的<color=#28d9ed>命中</color>效果提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000070_1_1]回合</color>。\n\n目标附带<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果时，该技能的伤害提升。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies, and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Shocked</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_2_1] turn(s)</color>.\n\nDamage dealt increases when the target is granted a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>感電</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_2_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。\n\nこのスキルは対象が<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>状態の場合、ダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고, 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>감전</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_2_1]턴</color>동안 부여합니다.\n\n이 스킬은 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 보유하고 있을 때 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并为全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>触电</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_2_1]回合</color>。\n\n目标附带<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果时，该技能的伤害提升。

name.jp: ワールド・イズ・アワーズ

desc.en:
Attacks all enemies.
After attacking, grants <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_3_2] turn(s)</color>.

Damage dealt increases when the target is granted a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color>.
desc.jp:
敵全体にダメージを与える。
攻撃後、自分に<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。

このスキルは対象が<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>状態の場合、ダメージがUPする。
desc.kr:
적 전체를 공격합니다.
공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_3_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color>을 획득합니다.

이 스킬은 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 보유하고 있을 때 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh:
攻击全体敌人。
攻击后获得<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000070_3_2]回合</color>。

目标附带<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果时，该技能的伤害提升。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy.\nHas a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_1_3]</color> chance to reduce Priority of the target by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_1_3]</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_1_3]</color>の確率で対象の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_1_3]</color>DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 적 대상을 공격합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_1_3]</color> 확률로 대상의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_1_3]</color> 감소 시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人目标。\n<color=#28d9ed>有[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_1_3]</color>的几率使目标的行动值降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_1_3]</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies.\nReduces Priority of the target by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_2_1]</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。\n対象の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_2_1]</color>DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n대상의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_2_1]</color> 감소 시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。\n使目标的行动值降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_2_1]</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies, and grants <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> to all allies except for the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_3_1] turn(s)</color>.\nAdditionally, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> on the enemy for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_2] turn(s)</color>, or when the enemy is granted Invulnerability, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_3] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、自分を除く味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。\nまた無敵状態の敵にスタンを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_3]ターン</color>、無敵状態でない敵にはスタンを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고, 자신을 제외한 아군에게 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_3_1]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.\n또한, 무적 상태의 적은 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_3]턴</color> 그 외의 적은 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_2]턴</color> 동안 스턴 상태로 만듭니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并使除自身以外的友军获得<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000069_3_1]回合</color>。\n使处于无敌状态的敌人和其他敌人陷入晕眩状态，分别持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_3]回合</color>和<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_2]回合</color>。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
At the start of the turn, when all surviving allies are not inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color>, grants an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.
When the caster is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color>, increases damage taken.
After the Boss is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Break</color>, irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> is no longer granted.
If an ally is inflicted with a debuff when hit, reduces Priority of all allies by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>. (Only once per turn)
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
ターン開始時、戦場にいる味方全体が<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>状態でない場合、自分に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間付与する。
自分が<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>状態の場合、受けるダメージがUPする。
ボスの<color=#28d9ed>ブレイク</color>後からは解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>が付与されない。
味方がダメージを受け、弱体効果を付与された場合、味方全体の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>DOWNさせる。(1ターンに1回のみ適用)
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
턴 시작 시 생존한 아군 모두 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color> 상태가 아니라면, 자신에게 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.
자신은 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color> 상태에서 받는 피해량이 증가합니다.
보스 <color=#28d9ed>브레이크</color> 이후부터 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color>은 부여되지 않습니다.
아군이 약화효과 피해 시 아군 전체의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소 합니다.(1턴 당 1회 가능)
desc.zh:
(被动效果)
回合开始时，若存活的所有友军未处于<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>状态时，自身获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。
自身在<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>状态下受到的伤害量提升。
首领<color=#28d9ed>力竭</color>后，将不会获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果。
友军受到弱化效果时，全体友军的行动值降低<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。(1回合仅限1次)

desc.en: Attacks an enemy, and grants a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000077_1_1] turn(s)</color> proportional to the caster's Defense.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、自分に<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000077_1_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。自分の防御力が高いほどシールド量がUPする。
desc.kr: 적 대상을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000077_1_1]턴</color> 동안 자신의 방어력에 비례한 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 획득합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人目标，并获得与自身防御力成正比的<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000077_1_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect) Grants increased Defense to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000077_2_5] turn(s)</color>, then attacks all enemies. <color=#28d9ed>Water</color> enemies take additional fixed damage equal to Kappa's Defense.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to the target's missing Health.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)味方全体の防御力を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000077_2_5]ターン</color>の間UPさせ、敵全体にダメージを与える。<color=#28d9ed>水属性</color>の敵に【カッパ】の防御力分の固定ダメージを追加で与える。\nこのスキルは対象の残りHPが低いほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과) 아군의 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000077_2_5]턴</color> 동안 증가시킨 후 적 전체를 공격합니다. <color=#28d9ed>수속성</color> 적은 카파의 방어력만큼 고정 피해를 추가로 받습니다.\n이 스킬은 대상의 잃은 체력 비율에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)使友军防御力提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000077_2_5]回合</color>后攻击全体敌人。对<color=#28d9ed>水属性</color>敌人额外造成相当于卡帕防御力数值的固定伤害。\n该技能根据目标损失的生命值比例等比提升伤害。

desc.en: Removes <color=#28d9ed>all</color> buffs and debuffs from the caster and target, and attacks an enemy. (Ignores the target's Resilience)\nWhen the enemy is <color=#28d9ed>Water</color> element or <color=#28d9ed>killed</color>, activates <color=#28d9ed>Exile</color>.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to the target's missing Health.
desc.jp: 自分と対象のすべての強化効果と弱体効果を<color=#28d9ed>すべて</color>解除し、敵単体にダメージを与える。(対象の効果抵抗を無視する)\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>水属性</color>、または<color=#28d9ed>倒れた</color>場合、<color=#28d9ed>【追放】</color>を使用する。\nこのスキルは対象の残りHPが低いほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 자신과 대상의 모든 강화 효과 및 약화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 해제하고, 적을 공격합니다.(대상의 효과 저항 무시)\n적이 <color=#28d9ed>수속성</color> 이거나 <color=#28d9ed>처치</color>된 경우 <color=#28d9ed>추방</color>을 사용합니다.\n이 스킬은 대상의 잃은 체력 비율에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 解除自身和目标附带的<color=#28d9ed>所有</color>强化效果和弱化效果，并攻击敌人(无视目标的效果抵抗)。\n敌人为<color=#28d9ed>水属性</color>或被<color=#28d9ed>击杀</color>时使用<color=#28d9ed>驱逐</color>。\n该技能根据目标损失的生命值比例等比提升伤害。

desc.en: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 5 turns, and increases Attack and Speed by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>. This effect lasts until the caster is inflicted with Break.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2], and deals lethal damage to all enemies. This Enraged has no duration.
desc.jp: 5ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、攻撃力とスピードが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>UPする。この効果はブレイクすると解除される。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】と【必殺スキル】</color>：WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]回復し、敵全体に致命的なダメージを与える。【狂暴化】の持続ターンはない。
desc.kr: 5턴마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 공격력과 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color> 증가합니다. 브레이크 되기 전까지 효과가 유지됩니다. \n\n<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> : WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]를 회복하고, 적 전체에게 치명적인 피해를 입힙니다. 광폭화 유지 시간은 없습니다.
desc.zh: 每5回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并使攻击力和速度提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>，效果将持续至进入力竭状态为止。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化和必杀技</color>：WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]，对全体敌人造成致命伤害。因陷入狂暴化而触发该技能后，狂暴化状态立即解除。

desc.en: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 5 turns, and increases Attack and Speed by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>. This effect lasts until the caster is inflicted with Break.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2], and deals lethal damage to all enemies. desc.en:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower, and increases Attack and Speed by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>. This effect lasts until the caster is inflicted with Break.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns, and recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]. Enraged lasts for 5 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>I Foresaw the Future</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Attacks all enemies, and grants a Barrier to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_6_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、攻撃力とスピードが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>UPする。この効果はブレイクすると解除される。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UPとダメージDOWN効果を3ターンの間付与し、WGを[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]回復する。【狂暴化】は5ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【未来を予知しました】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体にダメージを与え、自分にシールドを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_6_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 공격력과 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color> 증가합니다. 브레이크 되기 전까지 효과가 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고, WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]를 회복합니다. 광폭화는 5턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>미래를 예지했어요.</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_6_1]턴</color>동안 자신에게 실드를 부여합니다.
desc.zh:
若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并使攻击力和速度提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>。该效果将持续至陷入力竭状态为止。

<color=#28d9ed>进入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合，并使WG恢复[Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]。狂暴化持续5回合。

<color=#28d9ed>预见未来</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
攻击全体敌人，使自身获得护盾效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_6_1]回合</color>。

desc.zh:
每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法被解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>预见未来</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
解除自身全部弱化效果，恢复所有技能冷却时间和生命值。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade13] turn(s)</color>. If the caster already has increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Damage</color>, activates <color=#28d9ed>The People on Earth</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade13]ターン</color>の間UPする。<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージ</color>がUPした状態の場合、<color=#28d9ed>【地にありては者】</color>を使用する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade13]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 증가합니다. <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해</color>가 증가한 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>땅에는 인간이</color>를 사용합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并使<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade13]回合</color>。若<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>处于提升的状态，则使用<color=#28d9ed>地上有人类</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Damage</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade15] turn(s)</color>. If the caster already has increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color>, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Petrified</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade16] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade15]ターン</color>の間UPする。<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>がUPした状態の場合、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade16]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade15]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해</color>가 증가합니다. <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 증가한 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade16]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>석화</color>를 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并使<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade15]回合</color>。若<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>处于提升状态，则对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade16]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. If the target is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Petrified</color>, it becomes an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Petrified</color> that lasts for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade17] turn(s)</color>. This attack ignores the target's Resilience and Immunity.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。対象が<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>状態の場合、解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>に切り替わり、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade17]ターン</color>の間付与する。この攻撃は、対象の効果抵抗と免疫を無視する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. 공격 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>석화</color> 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade17]턴</color> 동안 해제가 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>석화</color>로 변경합니다. 이 공격은 대상의 효과 저항과 면역을 무시합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。若攻击目标处于<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>状态，则变更为无法解除的<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade17]回合</color>。该攻击无视目标的效果抵抗与免疫。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
At the end of the turn, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Petrified</color> on a random enemy for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade18] turn(s)</color>.

Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade8]</color> when not <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>.
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
ターン終了時、ランダムの敵単体に<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade18]ターン</color>の間付与する。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態でない場合、受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade8]</color>DOWNする。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
턴 종료 시, 무작위 적 한 명에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade18]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>석화</color>를 부여합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태가 아니라면 받는 WG 피해량을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade8]</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh:
(被动效果)
回合结束时，使随机1名敌人陷入<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade18]回合</color>。

若未处于<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，则使受到的WG伤害量降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade8]</color>。

desc.en:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Grants an irremovable effect to the caster that increases Attack and reduces damage taken for 3 turns. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>An Inadequate World</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Deals lethal damage to all enemies.
desc.jp:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可能な攻撃力UP・ダメージDOWNを3ターンの間付与する。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。

<color=#28d9ed>【世界の果て】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
敵全体に致命的なダメージを与える｡
desc.kr:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. 

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>세계의 한계</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체에게 치명적인 피해를 입힙니다.
desc.zh:
若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：使自身获得无法解除的攻击力提升/伤害降低效果，持续3回合。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>世界的极限</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
对全体敌人造成致命伤害。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. After attacking, grants a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade19] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、自分に<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade19]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. 공격 후 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade19]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。攻击后，使自身获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade19]回合</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\nThe caster takes <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade20]</color> of damage taken by allies in their place.\nGreatly reduces damage taken from Area of Effect Attacks.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n味方の受けるダメージの<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade20]</color>を自分が代わりに受ける。\n全体攻撃で受けるダメージが大幅にDOWNする。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n아군이 받는 피해의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade20]</color>를 자신이 대신 받습니다.\n전체 범위 공격으로 받는 피해가 크게 감소합니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)\n自身代替友军承受<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade20]</color>的伤害。\n所受全体范围攻击伤害大幅降低。

desc.en: Deals <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade22]</color> of the target's Max Health as fixed damage before attacking an enemy.
desc.jp: 対象の最大HP<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade22]</color>の固定ダメージを与えた後、敵単体にダメージを与える。
desc.kr: 대상 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade22]</color> 만큼 고정 피해를 입힌 후 적을 공격합니다.
desc.zh: 对目标造成相当于其生命值上限<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade22]</color>的固定伤害后，攻击敌人。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and reduces <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the target by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade23]</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade23]</color>DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고, 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade23]</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并使目标的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade23]</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. Inflicts <color=#28d9ed>instant death</color> on the target if the target's <color=#28d9ed>current Health</color> is <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade24]</color> or below.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。対象の<color=#28d9ed>残りHP</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade24]</color>以下の場合、対象を<color=#28d9ed>即死</color>させる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>현재 체력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade24]</color> 이하라면 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>즉사</color>시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。若目标的<color=#28d9ed>当前生命值</color>在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade24]</color>以下，则使目标<color=#28d9ed>即死</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\nAt the start of battle, grants <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade31] turn(s)</color>. Killing an enemy creates the same effect, and this effect is irremovable.\nWhen taking a critical hit, fully reduces the cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>Dragon Ruler's Breath</color>, and increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade26]</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n戦闘開始時、味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade31]ターン</color>の間付与する。敵を倒した場合にも同じ効果が付与され、この効果は解除されない。\n会心ダメージを受けた時、<color=#28d9ed>【竜王の息吹】</color>のスキルターンが初期化し、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade26]</color>UPさせる。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n전투 시작 시 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade31]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color>을 부여합니다. 적을 처치하면 동일한 효과가 생성되며, 이 효과는 해제되지 않습니다.\n치명 공격 당할 시 <color=#28d9ed>용왕의 숨결</color>의 쿨타임이 모두 감소하며, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade26]</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)\n战斗开始时，对全体友军造成<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade31]回合</color>。若击杀敌人，则触发相同效果，且该效果不会被解除。\n受到暴击时，使<color=#28d9ed>龙王吐息</color>的冷却时间全部降低，且使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade26]</color>。

desc.en:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of Max Health or lower.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Does not take Weakness Gauge damage permanently. Enraged lasts for 3 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Dragon of Conquest</color>: Used when Enraged ends.
Permanently increases <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> and enhances <color=#28d9ed>Dragon Ruler's Breath</color> to target all enemies. These effects cannot be removed.
desc.jp:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：永続的にWGダメージを受けない。

<color=#28d9ed>【征服の竜】</color>：【狂暴化】終了時に発動する。
永続的に<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>がUPし、<color=#28d9ed>【竜王の息吹】</color>の攻撃範囲が全体攻撃に変わる。この効果は解除されない。
desc.kr:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. 

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 영구적으로 WG피해를 받지 않습니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>정복의 용</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
영구적으로 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 증가하고, <color=#28d9ed>용왕의 숨결</color>의 공격 범위가 적 전체로 확대됩니다. 이 효과들은 해제되지 않습니다.
desc.zh:
若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：永久不会受到WG伤害。狂暴化持续3回合。

<color=#28d9ed>征服之龙</color>：狂暴化结束时发动。
永久获得<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提升，并使<color=#28d9ed>龙王吐息</color>的攻击范围扩大至全体敌人。这些效果不会被解除。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade33] turn(s)</color>. This effect cannot be removed.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade33]ターン</color>の間付与する。この効果は解除されない。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade33]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 부여합니다. 이 효과는 해제되지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade33]回合</color>。该效果不会被解除。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. Detonates all Burned stacks on the target, and increases damage dealt by detonation by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade34]</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。対象に付与された火傷をすべて破裂させ、破裂のダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade34]</color>UPする。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 대상의 화상을 모두 폭발시키며, 폭발에 의한 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade34]</color> 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。使目标的所有烧伤爆发，且因爆发造成的伤害提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade34]</color>。

desc.en: Removes <color=#28d9ed>all</color> <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color> from all enemies, then attacks.\nAfter attacking, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade33] turn(s)</color>. This effect cannot be removed.
desc.jp: 敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>すべて</color>解除した後、敵全体にダメージを与える。\n攻撃後、対象に<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade33]ターン</color>の間付与する。この効果は解除されない。
desc.kr: 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 해제 후 공격합니다.\n공격 후 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade33]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 부여합니다. 이 효과는 해제되지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 解除全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>所有</color><color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>后发动攻击。\n攻击后，对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade33]回合</color>。该效果不会被解除。

name.jp: ツイン・メガキャノン

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and increases the target's Ultimate Skill cooldown by <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象の必殺スキルのターンを<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>増加させる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 대상의 필살기 쿨타임을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并使目标的必杀技冷却时间增加<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
When the caster removes buffs from an enemy, gains <color=#28d9ed>Destroyer's Punishment</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade36] turn(s)</color>.
(Triggered Effect) When the caster uses an attack that targets all enemies, uses <color=#ffd732>Heavy Metal Raptor</color>. (Excluding Skill Chains)

<color=#ffd732>Heavy Metal Raptor</color>: Attacks all enemies.
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
自分が敵の強化効果を解除した場合、自分に<color=#28d9ed>【破壊者の戒め】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade36]ターン</color>の間付与する。
(発動効果)自分が全体攻撃を使用時、<color=#ffd732>【ヘヴィメタルラプター】</color>を発動する。(チェーンスキルでは発動しない)

<color=#ffd732>【ヘヴィメタルラプター】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与える。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
자신이 적의 강화 효과를 해제시키면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade36]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>파괴자의 응징</color>을 획득합니다.

若自身解除敌人的强化效果，则获得<color=#28d9ed>破坏者的惩戒</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade36]回合</color>。

desc.kr: 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 해제 후 공격합니다.\n공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_upgrade41]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>회복 불가</color>를 부여합니다.

name.jp: ヘヴィメタルイーグル

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\nIncreases damage dealt proportional to the number of debuffs inflicted on the target.\nWhen inflicting a debuff on an enemy, recovers <color=#28d9ed>Health</color> of all allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade43]</color>.

desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n대상이 보유한 약화효과가 많을수록 적에게 입히는 피해가 증가합니다.\n적에게 약화 효과 적중 시 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade43]</color> 회복시킵니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)\n目标附带的弱化效果越多，对敌人造成的伤害越高。\n对敌人造成弱化效果时，使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade43]</color>。

desc.en: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>40%</color> of Max Health or lower.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Permanently inflicts <color=#28d9ed>increased damage taken</color> on all enemies. This effect ignores the target's Immunity and Resilience, and cannot be removed.
desc.jp: 最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】と【必殺スキル】</color>：敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>受けるダメージUP</color>を永続的に付与する。この効果は対象の免疫と効果抵抗を無視し、解除されない。
desc.kr: 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>40%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. \n\n<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> : 적 전체에게 영구적으로 <color=#28d9ed>받는 피해 증가</color>를 부여합니다. 이 효과는 대상의 면역과 효과 저항을 무시하며, 해제되지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>40%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化和必杀技</color>：对全体敌人造成永久<color=#28d9ed>所受伤害提升</color>效果。该效果无视目标的免疫和效果抵抗，且不会被解除。

Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>60%</color> of Max Health or lower.

desc.zh: (被动效果)单次所受伤害不会超过自身生命值上限的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_licence_upgrade64]</color>。(包含夹攻与额外攻击)\n所有攻击发动后，不会触发敌人的反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。\n(触发效果)受到暴击时，对目标使用<color=#28d9ed>严刑拷打</color>进行反击。

desc.en: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> of Max Health or lower.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>: Attacks all enemies. Does not take Weakness Gauge damage permanently, and increases Critical Hit Chance. This effect cannot be removed.
desc.jp: 最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：永続的にWGダメージを受けなくなり、会心率がUPする。この効果は解除されない。
desc.kr: 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다. \n\n<color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> : 적 전체를 공격합니다. 영구적으로 WG피해를 받지 않고, 치명 확률이 증가합니다. 이 효과는 해제되지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化</color>：永久不会受到WG伤害，暴击率提升。该效果不会被解除。

desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_licence_week_4]回合</color>，并且<color=#28d9ed>核心过载</color>的固定伤害量提升<color=#28d9ed>1000</color>。

(Passive Effect)
When an enemy inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> ends their turn, reduces the duration of <color=#28d9ed>buff(s)</color> granted to all enemies inflicted with Bleeding by <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.
When all allies except for the caster have been killed, reduces damage taken, increases damage dealt, and does not take Weakness Gauge damage.
Does not take Weakness Gauge damage and reduces damage taken from targets inflicted with a debuff.
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状態の敵がターン終了時、出血状態の敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>の持続ターンを<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>DOWNさせる。

(패시브 효과)
<color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 보유한 적이 턴 종료 시 출혈을 보유한 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>의 지속 시간이 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color>감소합니다.
자신을 제외한 아군이 모두 사망했다면 받는 피해가 감소하고, 주는 피해가 증가하며 WG피해를 받지 않습니다.

附带<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果的敌人回合结束时，使附带出血效果的全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>持续时间降低<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。
若除自身外所有友军全部死亡，则所受伤害降低，造成的伤害提升，且不会受到WG伤害。
不会受到来自附带弱化效果目标的WG伤害，且所受伤害降低。

Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>70%</color> of Max Health or lower.

Deals lethal damage to all enemies.

最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>70%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

적 전체에게 치명적인 피해를 입힙니다.

若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>70%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。
