desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>저주</color>가 부여되지 않은 경우 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>추가 피해를 줍니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，若目标未持有<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>，则造成<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>额外伤害。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Curse</color> on targets for <color=#28d9ed>3 turns</color>.\nGains an <color=#28d9ed>Extra Turn</color> when an enemy is defeated.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>3ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>を付与する。\n敵を撃破すると<color=#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>3턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>저주</color>를 부여합니다.\n적 처치 시 <color=#28d9ed>추가 턴</color>을 획득합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，对目标附加<color=#28d9ed>3回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>。\n击败敌人时获得<color=#28d9ed>额外回合</color>。

desc.en: At the start of every turn, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Curse</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.\nCurse DMG dealt to enemies decreases by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.
desc.jp: 毎ターン開始時、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>付与する。\n敵に与える呪いダメージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>減少する。
desc.kr: 매 턴 시작 시 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>저주</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 부여합니다.\n적에게 입히는 저주 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소합니다.
desc.zh: 每回合开始时对全体敌人附加<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>。\n对敌人造成的诅咒伤害减少<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。

desc.en:
DMG dealt by all enemies increases by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> per <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color> they hold.
(The more debuffs held, the more DMG dealt to Verdandi increases.)
When a target with <color=#28d9ed>Immunity</color> ends their turn, recovers WG by <color=#28d9ed>2</color>.
Curse and Fixed DMG taken by the boss cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>50000</color>.
desc.jp:
敵全体は自分が保有する<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果1個</color>あたり、ダメージが<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>増加する。
（弱体効果を多く保有するほど、ヴェルダンディへの与ダメージが増加する）
<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>を保有する対象の行動終了時、WGを<color=#28d9ed>2</color>回復する。
ボスが受ける呪いおよび固定ダメージは<color=#28d9ed>50000</color>を超えない。
desc.kr:
적 전체는 자신이 보유한 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과 1개</color> 마다 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 증가합니다.
(약화 효과를 많이 보유할 수록 베르단디에게 입히는 피해가 증가합니다)
<color=#28d9ed>면역</color> 보유 대상 행동 종료 시 WG를 <color=#28d9ed>2</color> 회복합니다.
보스가 받는 저주 및 고정 피해의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>50000</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
desc.zh:
全体敌人每持有1个<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，造成的伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。
（持有的弱化效果越多，对贝尔丹迪造成的伤害越高）
持有<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>的目标行动结束时，恢复WG<color=#28d9ed>2</color>点。
首领受到的诅咒及固定伤害不超过<color=#28d9ed>50000</color>。

desc.en:
Enters <color=#28d9ed>Berserk</color> state every time enemies take 6 actions.

<color=#28d9ed>Berserk Entry & Ultimate Skill</color> : Attacks all enemies, then grants self an irremovable Speed Increase/DMG Reduction effect for 1 turn and recovers WG by 10%.
Before using the skill, dispels <color=#28d9ed>2</color> of all enemies' <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color>.
desc.jp:
敵が6回行動するたびに<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状態に移行する。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化突入と必殺スキル</color>：敵全体にダメージを与えた後、自分に解除されないスピードUP/ダメージ減少効果を1ターンの間付与し、WGを10%回復する。
スキル使用前、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2個</color>解除する。
desc.kr:
적이 6회 행동할 때 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> :적 전체를 공격 후 자신에게 해제되지 않는 속도 증가/피해 감소 효과를 1턴 동안 부여하고 WG를 10% 회복합니다.
스킬 사용 전 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>2개</color> 해제합니다.
desc.zh:
敌人每行动6次进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化突入与必杀技</color>：攻击全体敌人后，对自身附加无法解除的速度提升/伤害减少效果1回合，并恢复WG10%。
使用技能前解除全体敌人<color=#28d9ed>2个</color><color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>.
desc.jp: 敵にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>増加させる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. Inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Unbuffable</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>. (Ignores Immunity)
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>強化不可</color>を付与する。（免疫無視）
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>강화 불가</color>를 부여합니다. (면역 무시)
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。对全体敌人附加<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>强化不可</color>。（无视免疫）

desc.en: Attacks all enemies.\nIncreases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> and decreases all enemies' <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。\n自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>増加させ、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>減少させる。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. \n자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 증가시키고 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。\n使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>，使全体敌人<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>减少<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。

desc.en: DMG taken from enemies with <color=#28d9ed>90%</color> or less current HP increases by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.\nDeals <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> bonus DMG to enemies with higher <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> than self.\nCurse and Fixed DMG taken by the boss cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>50000</color>.
desc.jp: 現在HPが<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>以下の敵から受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>増加する。\n自分より<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が速い敵に<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>の追加ダメージを与える。\nボスが受ける呪いおよび固定ダメージは<color=#28d9ed>50000</color>を超えない。
desc.kr: 현재 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>90%</color> 이하인 적에게 입는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 증가합니다.\n자신보다 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 빠른 적에게 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 추가 피해를 입힙니다.\n보스가 받는 저주 및 고정 피해의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>50000</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 受到当前生命值在<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>以下敌人的伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。\n对速度比自身快的敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>额外伤害。\n首领受到的诅咒及固定伤害不超过<color=#28d9ed>50000</color>。

desc.en: At the start of every turn, increases all enemies' Speed by <color=#28d9ed>5%</color>. (Max 5 stacks)\nDMG taken from enemies slower than self increases by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.
desc.jp: 毎ターン開始時、敵全体のスピードを<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>増加させる。（最大5回累積）\n自分より<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が遅い敵から受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>増加する。
desc.kr: 매 턴 시작 시 적 전체의 속도를 <color=#28d9ed>5%</color> 증가시킵니다. (최대 5회 누적)\n자신보다 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 느린 적에게 입는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 每回合开始时使全体敌人速度增加<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>。（最多叠加5次）\n受到比自身速度慢的敌人的伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。

desc.en:
Enters <color=#28d9ed>Berserk</color> state every time enemies take 6 actions.

<color=#28d9ed>Berserk Entry & Ultimate Skill</color> : Grants self an undispellable Speed UP/DMG Reduction effect for 1 turn and recovers WG by 10%.
Increases own Critical Hit Chance for 2 turns.
desc.jp:
敵が6回行動するたびに<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状態に移行する。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化突入と必殺スキル</color>：自分に解除されないスピードUP/ダメージ減少効果を1ターンの間付与し、WGを10%回復する。
自分の会心率を2ターンの間増加させる。
desc.kr:
적이 6회 행동할 때 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 속도 증가/피해 감소 효과를 1턴 동안 부여하고 WG를 10% 회복합니다.
자신의 치명 확률을 2턴 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh:
敌人每行动6次进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化突入与必杀技</color>：对自身附加无法解除的速度提升/伤害减少效果1回合，并恢复WG10%。
使自身暴击率在2回合内提升。

desc.en: Prioritizes attacking the leftmost enemy.\nIf the target is not a Defender, removes <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_Singularity_KS_SKILL01_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>buff(s)</color> from the target.
desc.jp: 最も左にいる敵を優先して攻撃する。\n対象が防御型でなければ、対象の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_Singularity_KS_SKILL01_1]</color>個解除する。
desc.kr: 가장 좌측에 있는 적을 우선적으로 공격합니다.\n대상이 방어형이 아니라면 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_Singularity_KS_SKILL01_1]</color>개 해제합니다.
desc.zh: 优先攻击最左侧的敌人。\n若目标不是防禦型，则解除目标的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_Singularity_KS_SKILL01_1]</color>个<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>。

desc.en: (Triggered Effect)\nAfter using <color=#28d9ed>Command: Restrain</color>, if the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> is increased, activates an additional attack on all enemies.
desc.jp: （発動効果）\n<color=#28d9ed>命令：制圧</color>使用後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>が上昇した状態なら敵全体に追加攻撃を与える。
desc.kr: (발동 효과)\n<color=#28d9ed>명령:제압</color> 사용 후 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>이 증가한 상태라면 적 전체에게 추가 공격을 입힙니다.
desc.zh: （触发效果）\n使用<color=#28d9ed>命令：压制</color>后，若自身<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>处于提升状态，则对全体敌人造成追加攻击。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_Singularity_KS_SKILL03_1] turns</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体を攻撃し、自分の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_Singularity_KS_SKILL03_1]ターン</color>増加させる。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_Singularity_KS_SKILL03_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并使自身<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_Singularity_KS_SKILL03_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: DMG taken from Strikers increases by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_a_1]</color>, and DMG taken increases by <color=#28d9ed>25%</color> for each Water enemy.\nIf there are no Defenders on the enemy team, all skills deal Fixed DMG equal to <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> of the target's Max Health before attacking.\nDamage from Cursed and Fixed DMG taken by Bosses cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>50,000</color>.
desc.jp: 攻撃型から受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_a_1]</color>増加し、水属性の敵1人につき受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>25%</color>増加する。\n敵チームに防御型がいない場合、すべてのスキルが攻撃前に対象の最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>分の固定ダメージを与える。\nボスが受ける呪いおよび固定ダメージのダメージは<color=#28d9ed>50,000</color>を超えない。
desc.kr: 공격형에게 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_a_1]</color>증가하고 수속성 적 1명당 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>25%</color> 증가합니다.\n적 팀에 방어형이 없다면 모든 스킬이 공격 전 대상 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 만큼 고정 피해를 입힙니다.\n보스가 받는 저주 및 고정 피해의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>50,000</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 受到战士型造成的伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_a_1]</color>，每有1名水属性敌人，受到的伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>25%</color>。\n若敌方队伍中没有坦克型，所有技能在攻击前会造成相当于目标最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>的固定伤害。\n首领受到的诅咒及固定伤害的伤害不超过<color=#28d9ed>50,000</color>。

desc.en: Always gains <color=#28d9ed>Buff Enhancement</color>. This effect cannot be removed.\nAfter an enemy acts, if the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> is increased, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_b_2]</color>.\nAfter the caster's turn ends, decreases the <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of non-Water targets by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_b_3]</color>.
desc.jp: 常に<color=#28d9ed>強化促進</color>を得る。この効果は解除されない。\n敵行動後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>が上昇した状態なら自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_b_2]</color>増加させる。\n自分の行動終了後、水属性でない対象の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_b_3]</color>減少させる。
desc.kr: 항상 <color=#28d9ed>강화 촉진</color>을 얻습니다. 이 효과는 해제되지 않습니다.\n적 행동 후 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>이 증가한 상태라면 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_b_2]</color> 증가시킵니다.\n자신 행동 종료 후 수속성이 아닌 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_b_3]</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 始终获得<color=#28d9ed>强化促进</color>。此效果无法被解除。\n敌人行动后，若自身<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>处于提升状态，则使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_b_2]</color>。\n自身行动结束后，使非水属性目标的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_ks_b_3]</color>。

desc.en:
Enters <color=#28d9ed>Berserk</color> state every time enemies take 7 actions.

<color=#28d9ed>Berserk Entry & Ultimate Skill</color>: Deals DMG to all enemies, then grants self an irremovable Speed Increase/DMG Reduction effect for 1 turn and recovers WG by 10%.
Enemies killed by this skill cannot be Resurrected or Revived.
desc.jp:
敵が7回行動するたびに<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状態に移行する。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化突入と必殺スキル</color>：敵全体にダメージを与えた後、自分に解除されないスピードUP/被ダメDOWN効果を1ターン付与し、WGを10%回復する。
このスキルで倒れた敵は復活と蘇生ができなくなる。
desc.kr:
적이 7회 행동할 때 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> : 적 전체에게 피해를 입힌 후 자신에게 해제되지 않는 속도 증가/피해 감소 효과를 1턴 동안 부여하고 WG를 10% 회복합니다.
이 스킬로 사망한 적은 부활 및 소생이 불가능합니다.
desc.zh:
敌人每行动7次进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化冲入与必杀技</color>：对全体敌人造成伤害后，为自身附加无法解除的速度提升/受伤害降低效果持续1回合，并恢复10% WG。
被此技能击杀的敌人无法复活及复苏。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill01_1] turns</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill01_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill01_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，使自身<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill01_1]回合</color>内增加。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and decreases targets' <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill02_1]</color> turns. (Ignores Resilience)\nRight after using this skill, enemy Counterattack, Revenge, and Agile Response do not trigger.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill02_1]</color>ターンの間DOWNさせる。（効果抵抗無視）\nこのスキルの直後は、敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill02_1]</color>턴 동안 감소시킵니다. (효과 저항 무시)\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，使目标<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill02_1]</color>回合内减少。（无视效果抵抗）\n该技能使用后，敌方的反击、复仇、迅速应对不会发动。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. If a target has <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Speed</color>, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill03_1] turns</color> after attacking.\nRight after using this skill, enemy Counterattack, Revenge, and Agile Response do not trigger.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。対象が<color=#28d9ed>スピードDOWN</color>を保有している場合、攻撃後に対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill03_1]ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color>を付与する。\nこのスキルの直後は、敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다.대상이 <color=#28d9ed>속도 감소</color>를 보유하고 있다면 공격 후 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill03_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color>을 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。若目标持有<color=#28d9ed>速度降低</color>，攻击后对目标附加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_singularity_td_skill03_1]回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>。\n该技能使用后，敌方的反击、复仇、迅速应对不会发动。

desc.en: DMG taken from enemies faster than the caster increases by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_a_1]</color>.\nDMG dealt to enemies with <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Speed</color> increases by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_a_2]</color>.\nDamage from Cursed and Fixed DMG taken by Bosses cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>50000</color>.
desc.jp: 自分よりスピードが速い敵から受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_a_1]</color>UPする。\n<color=#28d9ed>スピードDOWN</color>を保有している敵に与えるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_a_2]</color>UPする。\nボスが受ける呪いおよび固定ダメージのダメージは<color=#28d9ed>50000</color>を超えない。
desc.kr: 자신보다 속도가 빠른 적에게 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_a_1]</color> 증가합니다.\n속도 감소를 보유한 적에게 가하는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_a_2]</color> 증가합니다.\n보스가 받는 저주 및 고정 피해의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>50000</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 受到速度比自身更快的敌人造成的伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_a_1]</color>。\n对持有<color=#28d9ed>速度降低</color>的敌人造成的伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_a_2]</color>。\n首领受到的诅咒及固定伤害不超过<color=#28d9ed>50000</color>。

desc.en: At the start of battle, takes the first turn and grants the caster irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Defense</color> if there is exactly 1 Ranger on the enemy team.\nAt the start of a non-Earth target's turn, increases the caster's Priority by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_b_2]</color>.
desc.jp: 戦闘開始時、最初にターンを得て、敵にスピード型が1人いる場合、自分に解除不可能な<color=#28d9ed>防御力DOWN</color>を付与する。\n地属性でない対象のターン開始時、自分の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_b_2]</color>増加させる。
desc.kr: 전투 시작 시 가장 빠르게 턴을 획득하고 적 팀에 속도형이 1명 있다면 자신에게 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>방어력 감소</color>를 부여합니다.\n지속성이 아닌 대상 턴 시작 시 자신의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_b_2]</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 战斗开始时最先获得回合，若敌方队伍中有1名速度型，则对自身附加无法解除的<color=#28d9ed>防御力降低</color>。\n非土属性目标回合开始时，使自身行动值增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_passive_td_b_2]</color>。

desc.en:
Enters <color=#28d9ed>Berserk</color> state every time enemies take 7 actions.

<color=#28d9ed>Berserk Entry & Ultimate Skill</color>: Deals DMG to all enemies, then grants the caster an irremovable DMG Reduction effect for 1 turn and recovers WG by 10%.
Increases the caster's Priority by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_rage_td]</color>.
desc.jp:
敵が7回行動するたびに<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状態に移行する。

<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化突入と必殺スキル</color>：敵全体にダメージを与えた後、自分に解除されないダメージ減少効果を1ターンの間付与し、WGを10%回復する。
自分の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_rage_td]</color>増加させる。
desc.kr:
적이 7회 행동할 때 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> : 적 전체에게 피해를 입힌 후 자신에게 해제되지 피해 감소 효과를 1턴 동안 부여하고 WG를 10% 회복합니다.
자신의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_rage_td]</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh:
敌人每行动7次，转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>进入狂暴化与必杀技</color>：对全体敌人造成伤害后，对自身附加无法解除的伤害减少效果持续1回合，并恢复10%的WG。
使自身行动值增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_singularity_rage_td]</color>。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect) The boss monster's Priority increases after entering Berserk state. The following effects are added depending on rank.

<color=#ffd732>Applies from RANK D:</color> DMG dealt by all attacks increases and DMG taken decreases. The values increase as rank rises, reaching their maximum at SSS. (Up to 300%/200% respectively)

<color=#ffd732>Applies from RANK B:</color> Final DMG taken and WG DMG taken from targets without elemental advantage decrease by <color=#28d9ed>70%/50%</color> respectively.

<color=#ffd732>Applies from RANK S:</color> Increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> by <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>.

<color=#ffd732>Class Synergy</color>: After an enemy acts, if there is exactly 1 enemy team member of the corresponding class, gains a special effect.

Mage: Enemy Striker DMG increases by 8% (Max 10 stacks)
Striker: Enemy Mage DMG increases by 8% (Max 10 stacks)
Healer: All enemies' DMG taken decreases by 8% (Max 10 stacks)
Defender: Boss Attack decreases by 2% (Max 5 stacks)
Ranger: The boss takes Fixed DMG equal to 1% of its Max Health
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果) ボスモンスターは狂暴化突入後、行動ゲージが増加する。ランクに応じて以下の効果が追加される。

<color=#ffd732>RANK Dから適用：</color> すべての攻撃に対する与ダメージが増加し、受けるダメージが減少する。ランクが上がるほど数値が増加し、SSSで最大になる。（それぞれ最大300%／200%）

<color=#ffd732>RANK Bから適用：</color> 有利属性ではない対象から受ける最終ダメージとWGダメージがそれぞれ<color=#28d9ed>70%／50%</color>減少する。

<color=#ffd732>RANK Sから適用：</color> 自分の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>増加させる。

<color=#ffd732>職業シナジー</color>：敵の行動後、敵チームの該当職業が1人の場合、特別な効果を得る。

魔法型：敵攻撃型ダメージ8%増加（最大10回累積）
攻撃型：敵魔法型ダメージ8%増加（最大10回累積）
回復型：敵全体が受けるダメージ8%減少（最大10回累積）
防御型：ボス攻撃力2%減少（最大5回累積）
スピード型：ボス最大HPの1%固定ダメージ
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과) 보스 몬스터는 광폭화 진입 후 행동 게이지가 증가합니다. 랭크에 따라 아래 효과가 추가됩니다.

<color=#ffd732>RANK D 부터 적용:</color> 모든 공격에 대해 주는 피해가 증가하고 받는 피해가 감소합니다. 랭크가 오를수록 수치가 증가하여 SSS에서 최대가 됩니다.(각각 최대 300%/200%)

<color=#ffd732>RANK B 부터 적용:</color> 유리한 상성이 아닌 대상에게 받는 최종 피해와 WG 피해가 각각 <color=#28d9ed>70%/50%</color> 감소합니다.

<color=#ffd732>RANK S 부터 적용:</color> 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 증가시킵니다.

<color=#ffd732>직업 시너지</color>: 적 행동 후, 적 팀의 해당 직업이 1명일 때 특별한 효과를 얻습니다.

마법형: 적 공격형 피해 8% 증가 (최대 10회 누적)
공격형: 적 마법형 피해 8%증가 (최대 10회 누적)
회복형: 적 전체 받는 피해 감소 8% (최대 10회 누적)
방어형: 보스 공격력 감소 2% (최대 5회 누적)
속도형: 보스 최대 체력 1% 고정 피해
desc.zh:
(被动效果) 首领怪物进入狂暴化后行动值增加。根据等级将追加以下效果。

<color=#ffd732>从RANK D开始适用：</color> 所有攻击造成的伤害增加，受到的伤害减少。等级越高数值越大，在SSS时达到最大值。（分别最大300%/200%）

<color=#ffd732>从RANK B开始适用：</color> 从无克制属性的目标处受到的最终伤害和WG伤害分别减少<color=#28d9ed>70%/50%</color>。

<color=#ffd732>从RANK S开始适用：</color> 使自身<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。

<color=#ffd732>职业增效</color>：敌方行动后，若敌方队伍中对应职业仅有1名，则获得特殊效果。

法师型：敌方战士型伤害增加8%（最多叠加10次）
战士型：敌方法师型伤害增加8%（最多叠加10次）
辅助型：敌方全体受到的伤害减少8%（最多叠加10次）
坦克型：首领攻击力减少2%（最多叠加5次）
敏捷型：首领最大生命值1%固定伤害

desc.en: Attacks an enemy.\nBefore attacking, if the caster's current Health is <color=#28d9ed>85%</color> or lower, restores <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_01]</color> of <color=#28d9ed>self</color>'s Max Health.\nIf the caster's current Health exceeds <color=#28d9ed>85%</color>, heals the ally with the lowest Health by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_02]</color> of Nella's Max Health.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\n攻撃前、自分の現在HPが<color=#28d9ed>85%</color>以下の場合、<color=#28d9ed>自分</color>の最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_01]</color>を回復する。\n攻撃前、自分の現在HPが<color=#28d9ed>85%</color>を超える場合、最もHPが低い味方のHPをネラの最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_02]</color>分回復する。
desc.kr:
적을 공격합니다.

공격 전 자신의 현재 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>85%</color> 이하라면 <color=#28d9ed>자신</color> 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_01]</color>를 회복합니다.

공격 전 자신의 현재 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>85%</color>를 초과한다면 체력 상황이 가장 나쁜 아군의 체력을 넬라 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_02]</color>만큼 회복시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。\n攻击前，若自身当前生命值≤<color=#28d9ed>85%</color>，则回复<color=#28d9ed>自身</color>最大生命值的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_01]</color>。\n攻击前，若自身当前生命值＞<color=#28d9ed>85%</color>，则为生命值最低的友军回复内拉最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_02]</color>的生命。

desc.en: (Triggered Effect) Triggers <color=#28d9ed>Rapid Response</color> upon being hit.\nIncreases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000083_2_2]</color> and heals all allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_03]</color> of Nella's Max Health.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)被弾時に<color=#28d9ed>迅速対応</color>が発動する。\n自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000083_2_2]</color>UPし、味方全体のHPをネラの最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_03]</color>分回復する。
desc.kr: (발동 효과) 피격 시 <color=#28d9ed>신속 대응</color> 효과가 발동합니다.\n자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000083_2_2]</color> 증가하며, 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 넬라 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_03]</color>만큼 회복시킵니다.
desc.zh: （触发效果）受到攻击时触发<color=#28d9ed>迅速应对</color>。\n自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000083_2_2]</color>，并为全体友军回复内拉最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_03]</color>的生命。

desc.en: Increases the <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of surviving allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000083_3_1]</color>, then <color=#28d9ed>Resurrects (Greater)</color> all fallen allies. Afterwards, heals all allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_03]</color> of Nella's Max HP and grants <color=#28d9ed>Immunity</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000083_3_4]</color> turn(s).\n\nAdditionally grants all allies except the caster <color=#28d9ed>Increased Attack</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Increased Penetration</color> for <color=#28d9ed>3 turns</color>.
desc.jp: 生存している味方の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000083_3_1]</color>UPした後、戦闘不能の味方全員を<color=#28d9ed>復活(強化)</color>させる。さらに味方全体のHPをネラの最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_03]</color>分回復し、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000083_3_4]</color>ターンのあいだ<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>を付与する。\n加えて自分以外の味方に<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力UP</color>と<color=#28d9ed>貫通力UP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>3ターン</color>付与する。
desc.kr: 생존한 아군의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000083_3_1]</color> 증가시킨 후, 사망한 아군 전체를 <color=#28d9ed>부활(강화)</color>시킵니다. 이후 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 넬라 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_03]</color>만큼 회복시키고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000083_3_4]턴</color> 동안 면역을 부여합니다.\n\n자신을 제외한 아군에게 추가적으로 <color=#28d9ed>3턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>공격력, 관통력</color> 증가 효과를 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 使存活友军的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000083_3_1]</color>，随后使全体阵亡友军<color=#28d9ed>复活(强化)</color>。之后为全体友军回复内拉最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_32_03]</color>的生命，并赋予<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000083_3_4]</color>回合。\n另外，为除自身外的友军赋予<color=#28d9ed>攻击力提升</color>与<color=#28d9ed>穿透力提升</color>持续<color=#28d9ed>3</color>回合。

desc.en: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 5 turns.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Removes all debuffs from self and deals massive damage to all enemies, then grants <color=#28d9ed>Immunity</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.
desc.jp: 5ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分の弱体効果をすべて解除し、敵全体に大ダメージを与え、その後、自分に<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>を付与する。
desc.kr: 5턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> : 자신의 약화 효과를 모두 해제하고 적 전체에게 치명적인 피해를 입힙니다. 이 후, 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>면역</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 每5回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化和必杀技</color>：解除自身所有弱化效果，对全体敌人造成巨大伤害，并为自身赋予<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color><color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>效果。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\nIncreases all allies' <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_apc_45_2_1]</color> each turn. (Stacks up to 8 times)
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n毎ターン、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_apc_45_2_1]</color>UPする。(最大8回まで累積)
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n매 턴 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_apc_45_2_1]</color> 증가합니다. (최대 8회 누적)
desc.zh: （被动效果）\n每回合全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_apc_45_2_1]</color>。（最多叠加8次）

name.jp: 意外なランドリーサービス

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\nHeals all allies' <color=#28d9ed>Health</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_34_1_tower_hard]</color> each turn, excluding the caster.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n毎ターン、自分を除く味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>HP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_34_1_tower_hard]</color>回復する。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n매 턴 자신을 제외한 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_34_1_tower_hard]</color> 회복합니다.
desc.zh: （被动效果）\n每回合除自身外全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_34_1_tower_hard]</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\nWhen hit by a Critical Hit, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Counterattack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.\nWhen an ally is hit (including the caster), increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n会心攻撃を受けた時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>反撃</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間UPする。\n味方（自分を含む）がダメージを受けた時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UPする。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
치명 피격 시 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>반격</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.

아군 피격 시(자신 포함) 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: （被动效果）\n受到暴击时，使自身<color=#28d9ed>反击</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。\n当友军（含自身）受到攻击时，使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。

desc.en: Always attacks the enemy on the left first. Attacks an enemy and summons an Ice Revenant, her underling. Does not summon a new Ice Revenant if one is already present.\nDeals increased damage if the target is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color>.
desc.jp: 常に左側の敵を優先して攻撃する。敵単体にダメージを与え、彼女の手下である【氷の亡霊】を召喚する。すでに【氷の亡霊】が戦場にいる場合は召喚しない。\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color>状態の場合、ダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 항상 좌측의 적을 먼저 공격합니다. 적을 공격하고 그녀의 하수인인 얼음 망령을 소환합니다. 이미 얼음 망령이 존재한다면 소환하지 않습니다.\n대상이 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color> 상태라면 피해량이 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 总是优先攻击左侧的敌人。攻击敌人，并召唤她的手下冰霜亡灵。若已存在冰霜亡灵，则不会进行召唤。\n目标处于<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>状态时，伤害量提升。

desc.en: (Passive Effect) Deals increased damage if the target is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color>.\n(Triggered Effect) When attacking a Frozen target, performs an additional attack on all enemies and reduces their <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076001_2_2]</color>. This attack ignores the target's Defense.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)対象が<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color>状態の場合、与えるダメージがUPする。\n(パッシブ効果)凍結状態の対象を攻撃時、敵全体に追加攻撃を行い、<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076001_2_2]</color>DOWNさせる。この攻撃は対象の防御力を無視する。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과) 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color> 상태라면 피해량이 증가합니다.\n(발동 효과) 빙결 대상 공격 시 적 전체에게 추가 공격을 사용하고, 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076001_2_2]</color> 감소시킵니다. 해당 공격은 대상의 방어력을 무시합니다.
desc.zh: （被动效果）当目标处于<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>状态时，造成的伤害提升。\n（触发效果）攻击冰冻目标时，对全体敌人发动追加攻击，并使其<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076001_2_2]</color>。该攻击无视目标防御力。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and reduces the <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> of the targets, then summons an Ice Revenant. Does not summon a new Ice Revenant if one is already present.\nDeals increased damage if the target is inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>をDOWNさせた後、【氷の亡霊】を召喚する。すでに【氷の亡霊】が戦場にいる場合は召喚しない。\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color>状態の場合、ダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 감소시킨 후 얼음 망령을 소환합니다. 이미 얼음 망령이 존재한다면 소환하지 않습니다.\n대상이 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color> 상태라면 피해량이 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并使目标的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低后，召唤冰霜亡灵。若已存在冰霜亡灵，则不会进行召唤。\n若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>状态，则伤害量提升。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
If none of Glicys's Servants are present, damage taken is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_34_02]</color>.
At the start of the turn, <color=#28d9ed>Freezes</color> the leftmost enemy for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4076001_12_1_1]</color> turn(s). If the leftmost enemy is dead or absent, this effect does not activate.
While a Servant is alive, when Glicys is hit by a single-target attack, recovers <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076001_11_3]</color> Weakness Gauge after being hit.
Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from non-Earth enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_1]</color>, increases damage dealt to them, and reduces damage taken from them.
Reduces damage dealt to Earth enemies and increases damage taken from them.
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
グリシスの従者がいない場合、グリシスが受けるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_34_02]</color>DOWNする。
ターン開始時、最も左の敵を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4076001_12_1_1]</color>ターンの間<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color>させる。最左の敵が死亡または不在の場合、この効果は発動しない。
従者が生存中にグリシスが単体攻撃を受けた場合、被弾後に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076001_11_3]</color>のWGを回復する。
地属性以外の敵から受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_1]</color>DOWNし、与えるダメージがUP、受けるダメージがDOWNする。地属性の敵に与えるダメージがDOWNし、受けるダメージがUPする。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
글리시스의 하수인들이 존재하지 않는다면, 글리시스가 받는 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_34_02]</color> 감소합니다.

턴 시작 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4076001_12_1_1]턴</color> 동안 가장 좌측의 적을 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color> 시킵니다. 가장 좌측의 적이 사망하거나 없다면 해당 효과는 작동하지 않습니다.

하수인이 생존 중 글리시스가 단일 공격을 받으면, 피격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076001_11_3]</color>의 WG를 회복합니다.

지속성이 아닌 적에게 받는 WG 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_1]</color> 감소하며 입히는 피해가 증가하고, 받는 피해가 감소합니다.
지속성 적에게 입히는 피해가 감소하고, 받는 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh:
（被动效果）
若场上不存在格里西丝的仆从，则其所受伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_34_02]</color>。
回合开始时，使最左侧敌人陷入<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4076001_12_1_1]</color>回合。若最左侧敌人已死亡或不存在，则不生效。
仆从存活期间，格里西丝受到单体攻击时，受击后恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076001_11_3]</color>点WG。
来自非土属性敌人的WG伤害量降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_armor_common_1]</color>，对其造成的伤害提升且所受伤害降低；对土属性敌人造成的伤害降低且所受伤害提升。

desc.en:
When the caster's Max Health falls below <color=#28d9ed>60%</color>, enters <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> state, increasing <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>. The effect lasts until broken.

<color=#28d9ed>Enrage Entry</color>: Grants the caster irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Effectiveness Up</color> for 3 turns and <color=#28d9ed>Invincibility</color> for 1 turn, then recovers WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2] and summons her minion, the Giant Ice Wraith. Enrage lasts for 3 turns, and if the enemy is <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color>, the caster uses <color=#28d9ed>Shatter</color> immediately after entering Enrage.

<color=#28d9ed>Ice Nine</color>: Used when Enrage ends.
Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Freeze</color>. This effect ignores Resilience.

<color=#ffd732>Restores 80 CP if Enrage is triggered within 3 turns.</color>
desc.jp:
最大HPが<color=#28d9ed>60%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に移行し、<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>上昇する。ブレイクされるまで効果が持続。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化突入】</color>：自分に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>効果命中UP</color>を3ターン、<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を1ターン付与し、WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]を回復。その後、従者である巨大氷霊を召喚する。狂暴化は3ターンの間続き、敵が<color=#28d9ed>氷結</color>状態の場合、狂暴化突入後に<color=#28d9ed>「砕け散れ」</color>を使用する。

<color=#28d9ed>【アイスナイン】</color>：狂暴化終了時に発動。
敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>氷結</color>状態にする。この効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。

<color=#ffd732>3ターン以内に狂暴化すると、CPを80回復する。</color>
desc.kr:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>60%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, 공격력과 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color> 증가합니다. 브레이크 되기 전까지 효과가 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 효과 적중 증가/무적 효과를 각각 3턴/1턴 동안 부여하고 WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]를 회복한 뒤 그녀의 하수인인 거대 얼음 망령을 소환합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지되며, 적이 빙결 상태라면 광폭화 돌입 후 <color=#28d9ed>깨져라</color>를 사용합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>아이스 나인</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고 대상을 빙결 상태로 만듭니다. 이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.

<color=#ffd732>3턴 안에 광폭화할 시 80의 CP를 회복시킵니다.</color>
desc.zh:
当自身最大生命值≤<color=#28d9ed>60%</color>时，进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，使<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>和<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_common_rage_buff_atk_hp]</color>。效果持续至被打破为止。

<color=#28d9ed>进入狂暴化</color>：为自身赋予不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中提升</color>（持续3回合）和<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>（持续1回合），并恢复WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]，随后召唤她的仆从——巨型冰灵。狂暴化持续3回合，若敌人处于<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>状态，则在进入狂暴化后立即施放<color=#28d9ed>粉碎吧</color>。

<color=#28d9ed>冰之终焉</color>：在狂暴化结束时施放。
攻击全体敌人并使其陷入<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>状态。该效果无视效果抵抗。

<color=#ffd732>在3回合内进入狂暴化时，恢复80点CP。</color>

name.jp: OK～! ワールド・イズ・アワーズ

desc.en: Attacks all enemies, then inflicts unremovable <color=#28d9ed>Speed Down</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Buff Block</color> for <color=#28d9ed>99 turns</color> before disappearing.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>99ターン</color>のあいだ解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>スピードDOWN</color>と<color=#28d9ed>強化不可</color>を付与して消滅する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>99턴</color> 동안 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>속도 감소, 강화 불가</color>를 부여한 뒤, 사라집니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并赋予<color=#28d9ed>99回合</color>的不可解除<color=#28d9ed>速度降低</color>与<color=#28d9ed>无法强化</color>后消失。

desc.en: If the caster is <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color>, takes Fixed Damage equal to <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of Max Health upon taking a turn.\nAt the end of the turn, dispels all <color=#28d9ed>debuffs</color> from self.\nIf defeated before using <color=#28d9ed>OK~! The World Is Ours</color>, grants all enemies unremovable <color=#28d9ed>Immunity</color> for <color=#28d9ed>99 turns</color> and greatly reduces damage taken by self.
desc.jp: 自分が<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>状態の場合、ターン獲得時に最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>分の固定ダメージを受ける。\nターン終了時、自分にかかったすべての<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を解除する。\n<color=#28d9ed>OK~! ザ・ワールド・イズ・アワーズ</color>を使用する前に戦闘不能になった場合、敵全体に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>を<color=#28d9ed>99ターン</color>付与し、自分が受けるダメージを大幅にDOWNする。
desc.kr:
자신이 <color=#28d9ed>저주</color> 상태라면 턴 획득 시점에 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 만큼 고정 피해를 받습니다.
턴 종료 시 자신에게 걸린 모든 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 해제합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>OK~! 더 월드 이즈 아워즈</color> 사용 전 사망 시, <color=#28d9ed>99턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>면역</color>을 부여하며, 자신이 입는 피해를 크게 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 若自身处于<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>状态，则在获得回合时受到等于最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的固定伤害。\n回合结束时，解除自身所有<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。\n在使用<color=#28d9ed>OK~! The World Is Ours</color>之前被击败时，为全体敌人赋予不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>持续<color=#28d9ed>99回合</color>，并大幅降低自身所受伤害。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color> chance to increase the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color> turn(s).
desc.jp: 敵単体を攻撃し、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>の確率で自分の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>ターンの間UPする。
desc.kr: 적 대상을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color> 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击1名敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>概率使自身<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_1_1]</color>回合。

desc.en: Removes <color=#28d9ed>all</color> debuffs from the caster and grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2] turn(s)</color>, then attacks an enemy.
desc.jp: 自分の弱体効果を<color=#28d9ed>すべて</color>解除し、<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>UP効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2]ターン</color>の間付与した後、敵単体にダメージを与える。
desc.kr: 자신에게 걸려 있는 약화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 제거하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color> 증가 효과를 부여한 뒤 적 대상을 공격합니다.
desc.zh: 解除自身附带的<color=#28d9ed>所有</color>弱化效果，并获得<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提升效果，持续 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_2_2]回合</color>后，攻击敌人目标。

name.jp: レクイエム・セルケト

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. Enemies defeated by this skill cannot be revived or resurrected.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。このスキルで倒れた敵は復活と蘇生ができなくなる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. 이 스킬로 사망한 적은 부활 및 소생이 불가능합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。被此技能击倒的敌人无法复活或复苏。

name.en: Scorpion Tail's One Hit, One Kill

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
At the start of battle, permanently grants the caster an un-dispellable <color=#28d9ed>Stealth</color> effect.
At the start of turn, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Critical Damage</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]</color> turn(s).
Each turn, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> by <color=#28d9ed>5%</color> (up to 10 stacks).
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
戦闘開始時、自分に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>隠密</color>を永続付与する。
ターン開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>と<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]</color>ターンの間UP。
毎ターン、自分の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>ずつUP（最大10回）。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
전투 입장 시 자신에게 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>은신</color> 효과를 영구적으로 부여합니다.
턴 시작 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]턴</color> 동안 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color> 및 <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해</color>가 증가합니다.
매 턴 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>5%</color>씩 증가합니다.(최대 10회 누적)
desc.zh:
（被动效果）
进入战斗时，永久获得不可驱散的<color=#28d9ed>潜行</color>效果。
回合开始时，自身<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>与<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000078_4_2]</color>回合。
每回合自身<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>（最多10层）。

desc.en: After the caster attacks, increases <color=#28d9ed>Eternal</color>'s <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color>. When an enemy uses a non-attack skill, attacks the target with <color=#28d9ed>Veil of Night</color> (ignores Veil of Night's cooldown).
desc.jp: 自分が攻撃した後、<color=#28d9ed>【エターナル】</color>の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>UPする。敵が攻撃以外のスキルを使用した時、<color=#28d9ed>【夜のヴェール】</color>で対象を攻撃する（スキルのスキルターン無視）。
desc.kr: 자신 공격 후, <color=#28d9ed>이터널</color>의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 증가시키고 적이 공격이 아닌 스킬 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>밤의 장막</color>으로 대상을 공격합니다.(밤의 장막 쿨타임 무시)
desc.zh: 自身攻击后，使<color=#28d9ed>「永恒」</color>的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>。当敌人使用非攻击技能时，以<color=#28d9ed>「夜之帷幕」</color>攻击其（无视该技能冷却）。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and grants <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> to the whole enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_37_03] turns</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_37_03]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_37_03]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_37_03]回合</color>内赋予全体敌人<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>。

desc.en: At the start of battle, greatly reduces all enemies' <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color>. When hit, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>.
desc.jp: 戦闘開始時、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を大幅DOWNする。被弾時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UP。
desc.kr: 전투 시작 시, 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 크게 감소시키며 피격 시 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 战斗开始时，大幅降低全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>。受击时，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。

desc.en:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Grants the caster un-dispellable Attack Up/DMG Reduction for 3 turns, recovers WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2], then inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>3</color> turns. Berserk lasts 3 turns.
<color=#28d9ed>Berserk Ultimate</color>: Used when Berserk ends. Attacks all enemies and <color=#28d9ed>Detonates</color> all <color=#28d9ed>Poison</color> effects on them.
desc.jp:
4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：自分に解除不可の攻撃力UP/被ダメージDOWNを3ターン付与し、WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]を回復。その後、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>3ターン</color>の間付与。【狂暴化】は3ターンの間持続する。
<color=#28d9ed>狂暴必殺</color>：狂暴終了時に使用。敵全体に攻撃し、付与された<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>をすべて<color=#28d9ed>爆発</color>させる。
desc.kr:
4턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 공격력 증가/피해 감소 효과를 3턴 동안 부여하고 WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]를 회복한 뒤, 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>3턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다. 광폭화는 3턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 필살기</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 공격하고 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 모두 <color=#28d9ed>폭발</color>시킵니다.
desc.zh:
每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化和必杀技</color>：为自身赋予不可驱散的攻击力提升/伤害降低，持续3回合；恢复WG [Buff_V_common_monster_passive_wg2]，随后对全体敌人施加<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>3</color>回合。狂暴持续3回合。
<color=#28d9ed>狂暴终技</color>：狂暴结束时施放。攻击全体敌人并<color=#28d9ed>引爆</color>其身上的全部<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>效果。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\At the start of the turn, Resurrects (Greater) all dead allies and increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\nターン開始時、倒れたすべての味方を復活(強化)させ、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UPする。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n턴 시작 시 사망한 모든 아군을 부활(강화)시키고, 본체의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)\n回合开始时，复活(强化)所有已死亡的友军，并使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\nWhen using <color=#28d9ed>Encircled field</color>, increases all allies' <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n<color=#28d9ed>炮烙ノ形</color>使用時、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_1]ターン</color>の間UPする。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n<color=#28d9ed>포락지형</color> 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_1]턴</color> 동안 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>이 증가합니다.
desc.zh: （被动效果）\n使用<color=#28d9ed>炮烙之刑</color>时，全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\nWhen using <color=#28d9ed>Encircled field</color>, increases all allies' <color=#28d9ed>Evasion</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_2] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n<color=#28d9ed>炮烙ノ形</color>使用時、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>回避</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_2]ターン</color>の間UPする。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n<color=#28d9ed>포락지형</color> 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_2]턴</color> 동안 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>회피</color>가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: （被动效果）\n使用<color=#28d9ed>炮烙之刑</color>时，全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>回避</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_2]回合</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\nWhen using <color=#28d9ed>Encircled field</color>, increases all allies' <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_3] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n<color=#28d9ed>炮烙ノ形</color>使用時、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_3]ターン</color>の間UPする。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n<color=#28d9ed>포락지형</color> 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_3]턴</color> 동안 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: （被动效果）\n使用<color=#28d9ed>炮烙之刑</color>时，全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_4044003_6_3]回合</color>。

name.jp: フラッシュプロトコル

desc.en: At the start of battle, takes the first turn.
desc.jp: 戦闘開始時、最速でターンを獲得する。
desc.kr: 전투 입장 시 가장 빠르게 턴을 획득합니다.
desc.zh: 进入战斗时，最先获得回合。

desc.en: At the start of the caster's turn, grants a Barrier to 1 ally for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_1034601_1_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 自分のターンが来るたびに、味方単体にシールドを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_1034601_1_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 자신의 턴 마다 아군 1체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_1034601_1_1]턴</color> 동안 실드를 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 每到自身回合时，使1名友军获得护盾效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_1034601_1_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: Upon entering battle, grants the caster an irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> effect.\n\nOn the caster's turn, deals <color=#28d9ed>Fixed Damage</color> equal to <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> of the caster's Max Health to all enemies.
desc.jp: 戦闘開始時、自分に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>を付与する。\n\n自分の行動時、敵全体に自分最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>分の<color=#28d9ed>固定ダメージ</color>を与える。
desc.kr: 전투 입장 시, 자신에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color> 효과를 부여합니다.\n\n자신 행동 시, 적 전체에게 최대 체력 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 만큼의 <color=#28d9ed>고정 피해</color>를 입힙니다.
desc.zh: 进入战斗时，为自身赋予不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>效果。\n\n自身行动时，对全体敌人造成等于自身最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>固定伤害</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_common_monster_buff_59]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_common_monster_buff_59] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_common_monster_buff_59]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_common_monster_buff_59]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_common_monster_buff_59]</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_common_monster_buff_59]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_common_monster_buff_59]</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_common_monster_buff_59]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000023_1_1]</color> chance to remove <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>debuff(s)</color> from all allies.\n Also heals the ally with the lowest Health for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_2]</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000023_1_1]</color>の確率で味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_1]個</color>解除する。\nまた、残りHPが最も低い味方単体のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_2]</color>回復する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000023_1_1]</color> 확률로 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_1]개</color> 해제합니다.\n또한 체력 상황이 가장 나쁜 아군의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_2]</color> 회복시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000023_1_1]</color>的几率解除全体友军<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_1]</color>个<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。\n并恢复生命值最低友军<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_2]</color>生命值。

desc.en: Heals all allies' <color=#28d9ed>Health</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_1]</color> of Saeran's Max Health. Additionally, recovers all other allies' <color=#28d9ed>Action Points</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_2]</color>. Removes <color=#28d9ed>1</color><color=#28d9ed>Debuff</color>of all Earth allies including the caster and grants <color=#28d9ed>Sustained Recovery</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1</color> turn(s). (The amount of healing is proportional to the target's Max Health).
desc.jp: 味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>HP</color>を【セイラン】の最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_1]</color>回復させ、【セイラン】を除く味方全体が<color=#28d9ed>AP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_2]</color>獲得する。\nまた、持続性味方の <color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1個</color>解除し、<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>継続回復</color>を付与する。（回復量は対象の最大HPが高いほどUP）
desc.kr:
아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 세이란 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_1]</color> 만큼 회복시키고, 세이란을 제외한 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>AP</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_2]</color> 회복시킵니다.
그리고 모든 지속성 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>1개</color> 해제시키고, <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color>동안 <color=#28d9ed>지속 회복</color>을 걸어줍니다. (대상의 최대 체력에 비례하여 회복합니다.)
desc.zh: 使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复相当于萨伊蓝最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_1]</color>，并使除萨伊蓝外的友军<color=#28d9ed>AP</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_2]</color>。\n同时为所有<color=#28d9ed>持续属性</color>友军解除1个<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，并赋予<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color><color=#28d9ed>持续恢复</color>。（恢复量与目标最大生命值成比例）

desc.en: Heals one ally by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_1]</color> and reduces the target's <color=#28d9ed>Skill Cooldown</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_2]turns(s)</color>. Additionally, removes all of the target's <color=#28d9ed>Debuff</color> and increases the target's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_3]</color>. \nGrants <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Increase Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turn(s)</color> if the target is an Earth ally.
desc.jp: 味方単体のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_1]</color>回復させた後、対象の<color=#28d9ed>スキルターン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_2]ターン</color>減少させる。また、対象のすべての<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を解除し、<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_3]</color>UPさせる。\n地属性対象に<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>と<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力UP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 아군 한 명의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_1]</color> 회복시킨 후, 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>스킬 쿨타임</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_2]턴</color> 감소시킵니다. 그리고 대상의 모든 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 해제하고 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_3]</color> 증가시킵니다.\n대상이 지속성인 경우 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color> 증가를 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 使1名友军的<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_1]</color>，并减少目标的<color=#28d9ed>技能冷却时间</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_2]</color>回合。\n解除目标的全部<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，并提升其<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_3]</color>。\n若目标为<color=#28d9ed>持续属性</color>友军，则赋予<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>与<color=#28d9ed>攻击力提升</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。

name.jp: デストラクションブレード

desc.en: Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000075_3_1]</color> chance to dispel <color=#28d9ed>all Buffs</color> from all enemies, then attacks all enemies.\nDeals greatly increased damage if the target is afflicted with a <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color>.
desc.jp: <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000075_3_1]</color>の確率で敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>すべて</color>解除し、敵全体に攻撃する。\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を受けている場合、ダメージが大幅UP。
desc.kr: <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000075_3_1]</color> 확률로 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>모두</color> 해제하고 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n대상이 약화 화과를 가진 상태라면 피해가 크게 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_boss_2000075_3_1]</color>概率解除全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>所有增益效果</color>，随后攻击全体敌人。\n若目标附带<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，伤害大幅提升。

name.jp: ヘヴィメタルイーグル

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
Each turn, reduces enemies' <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500155_4_1]</color>. This effect ignores Resilience (stacks up to 20).

At the start of battle, takes the first turn and greatly reduces damage taken from elements disadvantaged against the caster.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n毎ターン、敵の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500155_4_1]</color>DOWNさせる（効果抵抗無視、最大20回累積）。\n戦闘開始時、最速で行動し、自分に不利ではない属性から受けるダメージを大幅DOWNする。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
매 턴 적의 속도가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500155_4_1]</color> 감소합니다. 이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다. (최대 20회 누적)

전투 입장 시 가장 빠르게 턴을 획득하며 유리 속성에게 받는 피해량이 크게 감소합니다.
desc.zh: （被动效果）\n每回合使敌方<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500155_4_1]</color>（无视效果抵抗，最多叠加20次）。\n战斗开始时优先获得回合，并大幅降低来自对其不利元素的伤害。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color> chance to decrease all enemies' <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color> turn(s).\nAdditionally, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unhealable</color> on Earth enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color> turn(s).
desc.jp: 敵全体に攻撃し、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>の確率で敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>ターンの間DOWNさせる。\nさらに、地属性の敵に対しては<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>回復不可</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>ターン付与。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]턴</color> 동안 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 감소시킵니다.\n추가로 지속성 대상에게는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>회복 불가</color>를 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>概率使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>与<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_1]</color>回合。\n另外，对土属性目标有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>概率施加<color=#28d9ed>无法恢复</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_very_hard_monster_2000043_3_3]</color>回合。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
Grants an <color=#28d9ed>Extra Turn</color> upon using <color=#28d9ed>Can't Live Forever</color>.

<color=#28d9ed>Eternal</color> permanently gains irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Increased Effectiveness</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Increased Penetration</color> at the start of battle, but her own <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> is greatly reduced.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n<color=#28d9ed>『永遠には生きられない』</color>使用時、<color>#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。\n<color=#28d9ed>【エターナル】</color>は戦闘開始時に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>効果命中UP</color>と<color=#28d9ed>貫通UP</color>を永続で得る代わりに、自分の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が大幅にDOWNする。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
<color=#28d9ed>영원히 살 수는 없어</color> 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>추가 턴</color>을 획득합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>이터널</color>은 전투 입장 시 해제 불가능한 <color=#28d9ed>효과 적중 증가, 관통 증가</color>를 영구적으로 보유하는 대신, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 크게 감소합니다.
desc.zh: （被动效果）\n使用<color=#28d9ed>「不能永生」</color>时，获得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。\n<color=#28d9ed>「永恒」</color>在战斗开始时永久获得不可驱散的<color=#28d9ed>效果命中提升</color>与<color=#28d9ed>穿透提升</color>，但自身<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>将大幅降低。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000080_1_2]</color> chance to decrease the target's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_1_2]</color> turn(s).\nTriggers <color=#28d9ed>Dual Attacks</color> by two allies.
desc.jp: 敵を攻撃し、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000080_1_2]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_1_2]</color>ターンDOWNさせる。\n味方2人の<color=#28d9ed>連携</color>を発生させる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000080_1_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_1_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 감소시킵니다.\n아군 2인의 <color=#28d9ed>협공</color>을 발생시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000080_1_2]</color>概率使目标<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_1_2]</color>回合。\n触发2名友军的<color=#28d9ed>夹攻</color>。

desc.en: (Triggered Effect) When an ally is hit, counterattacks with <color=#28d9ed>Nirvana's Inferno</color>.\nBefore attacking, removes <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000080_2_2_1]</color> buff(s) from the target, and reduces Evasion for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_2_4_1] turn(s)</color>. If the target is <color=#28d9ed>Earth element</color>, ignores their Resilience, and does not miss.
desc.jp: (発動効果)味方がダメージを受けた時、<color=#28d9ed>【彼岸劫火】</color>で反撃する。\n(発動効果)攻撃前、対象に強化効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000080_2_2_1]個</color>解除し、回避を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_2_4_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。対象が<color=#28d9ed>地属性</color>の場合、対象の効果抵抗を無視し、ミスヒットが発生しない。
desc.kr: (발동 효과) 아군이 피격 시 <color=#28d9ed>피안의 겁화</color>로 반격 합니다.\n 공격 전 대상의 강화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000080_2_2_1]개</color> 해제하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_2_4_1]턴</color> 동안 회피를 감소시킵니다. 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>지속성</color>이라면 대상의 효과 저항을 무시하고, 빗나감이 발생하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: (触发效果)友军受到攻击时，用<color=#28d9ed>血液轮回</color>反击。\n攻击前解除目标的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000080_2_2_1]个</color>强化效果，并使回避降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_2_4_1]回合</color>。若目标为<color=#28d9ed>土属性</color>，则无视目标的效果抵抗，且不会触发闪避。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. Grants <color=#28d9ed>Sustained Recovery</color> to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_3_1] turn(s)</color>.\nThis skill ignores <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of the target's Defense.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>継続回復</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。\nこのスキルは対象の防御力を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>無視する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_3_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>지속 회복</color>을 부여합니다.\n이 스킬은 대상의 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 무시합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。使全体友军获得<color=#28d9ed>持续恢复</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000080_3_1]回合</color>。\n该技能无视目标防御力的<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>。

desc.en: Each turn, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> by <color=#28d9ed>5%</color> (up to 10 stacks).\nEach turn, increases all allies' <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> (up to 5 stacks).\nReduces damage taken while clones are alive.
desc.jp: 毎ターン、自分の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>ずつUP（最大10回）。\n毎ターン、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>が<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>ずつUP（最大5回）。\n分身が生存している間、受けるダメージがDOWN。
desc.kr: 매 턴 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>5%</color>씩 증가합니다.(최대 10회 누적)\n매 턴 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>씩 증가합니다.(최대 5회 누적)\n분신 생존 시 받는 피해가 감소합니다.
desc.zh: 每回合使自身<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>（最多10层）。\n每回合使全体友军<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>（最多5层）。\n分身存活时，所受伤害降低。

desc.en: Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> every 4 turns.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>Enraged Ultimate Skill</color>: Deals damage to all enemies, then <color=#28d9ed>Resurrects (Greater)</color> all allies. Afterwards, grants <color=#28d9ed>Continuous Healing</color> to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_38_06]</color> turn(s).
desc.jp: 4ターンごとに<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与え、味方全体を<color=#28d9ed>復活（強化）</color>させる。その後、味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>持続回復</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_38_06]</color>ターン付与する。
desc.kr: 4턴 마다 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.\n\n<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입과 필살기</color> : 적 전체에게 피해를 입힌 뒤, 모든 아군을 부활(강화)시킵니다. 이후, 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_38_06]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>지속 회복</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 每4回合转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>陷入狂暴化和必杀技</color>：对全体敌人造成伤害后，使全体友军<color=#28d9ed>复活（强化）</color>；随后为全体友军赋予<color=#28d9ed>持续恢复</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_38_06]</color>回合。

desc.en: Always targets the leftmost enemy first. Before attacking, dispels all <color=#28d9ed>Buffs</color> from the target, then attacks and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_39_02] turn(s)</color> (ignores Resilience).
desc.jp: 常に左側の敵を最優先で攻撃する。攻撃前に対象の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>をすべて解除してから攻撃し、対象を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_39_02]ターン</color>のあいだ<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>させる（効果抵抗無視）。
desc.kr: 항상 좌측의 적을 먼저 공격합니다. 공격 전 대상의 강화 효과를 모두 해제한 뒤 공격하고 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_39_02]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color> 상태로 만듭니다.(효과 저항 무시)
desc.zh: 总是先攻击最左侧的敌人。攻击前先解除目标的全部<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，随后进行攻击并使其陷入<color=#28d9ed>眩晕</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_tower_hard_mob_39_02]回合</color>（无视效果抵抗）。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect)
Increases the effectiveness of <color=#28d9ed>increased stat</color> effects on the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076009_4_5]</color>.

When attacked, does not take Weakness Gauge damage if the caster does not have a debuff.
Recovers <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076009_4_3]</color> Weakness Gauge upon scoring a critical hit on an enemy.

Reduces damage taken from <color=#28d9ed>Fire, Water, and Earth</color> enemies, and increases damage taken from <color=#28d9ed>Light and Dark</color> enemies.
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
自分に適用された<color=#28d9ed>ステータスUP</color>の効果が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076009_4_5]</color>UPする。

ダメージを受けた場合、自分に弱体効果がない場合はWGダメージを受けない。
敵を攻撃時、会心が発生した場合はWGを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076009_4_3]</color>回復する。

<color=#28d9ed>火・水・地属性</color>の敵から受けるダメージがDOWNし、<color=#28d9ed>光・闇属性</color>の敵から受けるダメージがUPする。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과)
자신에게 적용되는 <color=#28d9ed>능력치 증가</color> 효과가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076009_4_5]</color> 증가합니다.

피격 시 약화 효과가 없다면 WG 피해를 받지 않습니다.
적에게 치명 공격을 적중시키면 WG를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076009_4_3]</color> 회복합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>화속성, 수속성, 지속성</color> 적에게 받는 피해가 감소하고, <color=#28d9ed>명속성 및 암속성</color> 적에게 받는 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh:
(被动效果)
使自身附带的<color=#28d9ed>能力值提升</color>效果提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076009_4_5]</color>。

受到攻击时，若未附带弱化效果，则不会受到WG伤害。
若用暴击命中敌人，则WG恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4076009_4_3]</color>。

受到来自<color=#28d9ed>火属性、水属性、土属性</color>敌人的伤害降低，并使受到来自<color=#28d9ed>光属性、暗属性</color>敌人的伤害提升。

desc.en:
When the caster's Max Health is at or below <color=#28d9ed>70%</color>, becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color>.

<color=#28d9ed>Enrage Entry</color>: Grants the caster irremovable Damage Taken Reduction and Despair's Harmony for 4 turns. Enrage lasts for 4 turns.

<color=#28d9ed>Moonlit Nocturne</color>: Used when Enrage ends.
Instantly kills all enemies.
desc.jp:
最大HPが<color=#28d9ed>70%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わる。

<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化突入】</color>：自分に解除不可の被ダメージDOWNと〈絶望のハーモニー〉を4ターン付与。狂暴化は4ターン持続。

<color=#28d9ed>〈月夜のノクターン〉</color>：狂暴化終了時に使用。
敵全体を即死させる。
desc.kr:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>70%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>광폭화 돌입</color> : 자신에게 해제되지 않는 받는 피해 감소/절망의 하모니 효과를 4턴 동안 부여합니다. 광폭화는 4턴 동안 유지됩니다.

<color=#28d9ed>월야의 녹턴</color> : 광폭화 종료 시 사용.
적 전체를 사망시킵니다.
desc.zh:
当自身最大生命值≤<color=#28d9ed>70%</color>时，进入<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态。

<color=#28d9ed>进入狂暴化</color>：为自身赋予不可解除的伤害降低与「绝望的和声」，持续4回合。狂暴化持续4回合。

<color=#28d9ed>月夜夜想曲</color>：在狂暴化结束时发动。
使全体敌人立即死亡。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. If the target's <color=#28d9ed>current Health</color> is at or below <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500154_3_1]</color>, <color=#28d9ed>instantly kills</color> the target.\nIf the enemy dies, restores the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Health</color> by <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。対象の<color=#28d9ed>現在HP</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500154_3_1]</color>以下の場合、対象を<color=#28d9ed>即死</color>させる。\n対象が倒れた場合、自分の<color=#28d9ed>HP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>回復する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>현재 체력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500154_3_1]</color> 이하라면 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>즉사</color>시킵니다.\n적 대상이 사망하였을 경우, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> 회복합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。若目标的<color=#28d9ed>当前生命值</color>≤<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500154_3_1]</color>，则<color=#28d9ed>立即击杀</color>目标。\n若目标死亡，使自身<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)\nWhen taking a critical hit, fully reduces the cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>Dragon Ruler's Breath</color>, and increases <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500154_4_2]</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)\n会心ダメージを受けた時、<color=#28d9ed>【竜王の息吹】</color>のスキルターンが初期化し、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500154_4_2]</color>UPさせる。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과)\n치명 공격 당할 시 <color=#28d9ed>용왕의 숨결</color>의 쿨타임이 모두 감소하며, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500154_4_2]</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)\n受到暴击攻击时，使<color=#28d9ed>龙王吐息</color>的冷却时间全部减少，且使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_4500154_4_2]</color>。

desc.en:
At the start of battle, grants the caster irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> and <color=#28d9ed>DMG Reduction</color>, and reduces the <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> of the enemy with the highest Attack by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.

Each turn, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> by <color=#28d9ed>5%</color> (up to 10 stacks).
Damage the caster takes from <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Fixed Damage</color> cannot exceed <color=#28d9ed>10000</color>.
desc.jp:
戦闘開始時、自分に解除不可の<color=#28d9ed>貫通</color>と<color=#28d9ed>ダメージDOWN</color>を付与し、最も攻撃力が高い敵の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>DOWNさせる。

毎ターン、自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>ずつUP（最大10回累積）。
自分が受ける<color=#28d9ed>呪い／固定ダメージ</color>は<color=#28d9ed>10000</color>を超えない。
desc.kr:
전투 입장 시, 자신에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>관통, 피해 감소</color> 효과를 부여하고 가장 공격력이 높은 적의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소시킵니다.

매 턴 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>5%</color>씩 증가합니다.(최대 10회 누적)
자신이 입는 <color=#28d9ed>저주/고정 피해</color>의 피해는 <color=#28d9ed>10000</color>을 초과하지 않습니다.
desc.zh:
进入战斗时，为自身赋予不可解除的<color=#28d9ed>穿透</color>与<color=#28d9ed>伤害降低</color>，并使攻击力最高的敌人的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。

每回合使自身<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>（最多叠加10次）。
自身受到的<color=#28d9ed>诅咒/固定伤害</color>不超过<color=#28d9ed>10000</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000048_1_1]</color> chance to remove <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000048_1_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color> from the caster.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000048_1_1]</color>の確率で自分の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000048_1_1]個</color>解除する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000048_1_1]</color> 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000048_1_1]개</color> 해제합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000048_1_1]</color>的几率解除自身的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000048_1_1]个</color><color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect) Reduces the damage taken by all allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000048_2_1]</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)味方全体の受けるダメージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000048_2_1]</color>DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과) 아군 전체가 받는 피해를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000048_2_1]</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)使全体友军所受伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000048_2_1]</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. Grants a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> to the ally with the lowest Health for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000048_3_1] turns</color>. The Barrier strength is proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、残りHPが最も低い味方単体に<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000048_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。自分の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどシールド量がUPする。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 체력 상황이 가장 나쁜 아군에게 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000048_3_1]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다. 실드량은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并使生命值最低的友军获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000048_3_1]回合</color>。自身<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>越高，则护盾量越高。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color>.\nIf the caster has <color=#28d9ed>Fierce Offensive</color>, the effect is applied to <color=#28d9ed>all allies</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color>UPさせる。\n<color=#28d9ed>【アースエッジ】</color>がある場合、<color=#28d9ed>味方全体</color>の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>をUPさせる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color> 증가시킵니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>매서운 공세</color> 보유 시 <color=#28d9ed>아군 전체</color>에게 효과가 적용됩니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color>。\n附带<color=#28d9ed>猛烈攻势</color>效果时，将对<color=#28d9ed>全体友军</color>生效。

desc.en:
(Triggered Effect) Activates <color=#28d9ed>Crystal Storm</color> when an ally lands a debuff on their turn.

<color=#28d9ed>Crystal Storm</color>: Attacks all enemies, and inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
If the caster has <color=#28d9ed>Fierce Offensive</color>, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2] turn(s)</color>. If the target is a <color=#28d9ed>Healer</color>, additionally inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Silenced</color>.
desc.jp:
(発動効果)味方が自分のターンで敵に弱体効果を付与した場合、<color=#28d9ed>【大地の烈斬】</color>を使用する。

<color=#28d9ed>【大地の烈斬】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与え、対象の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
<color=#28d9ed>【アースエッジ】</color>がある場合、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。対象が<color=#28d9ed>回復型</color>の場合、追加で<color=#28d9ed>沈黙</color>を付与する。
desc.kr:
(발동 효과) 아군 팀이 자신의 턴에 적에게 약화 효과 적중 시 <color=#28d9ed>결정 쇄도</color>를 사용합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>결정 쇄도</color> : 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]턴</color> 동안 대상 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 감소시킵니다.
<color=#28d9ed>매서운 공세</color> 보유 시 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다. 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>회복형</color>이라면 추가적으로 <color=#28d9ed>침묵</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh:
(触发效果)友军在自身回合对敌人造成弱化效果时，使用<color=#28d9ed>晶体风暴</color>。

<color=#28d9ed>晶体风暴</color>：攻击全体敌人，并使全体目标的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]回合</color>。
附带<color=#28d9ed>猛烈攻势</color>效果时，对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]回合</color>。若目标为<color=#28d9ed>恢复型</color>，则额外造成<color=#28d9ed>沉默</color>效果。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. After attacking, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color>, and grants <color=#28d9ed>Fierce Offensive</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color>UPさせ、<color=#28d9ed>【アースエッジ】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1]ターン</color>の間獲得する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color> 증가시키고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>매서운 공세</color>를 획득합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color>，并获得<color=#28d9ed>猛烈攻势</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks the enemy.\nWhen scoring a critical hit, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000060_1_1]</color> chance to activate a <color=#28d9ed>Dual Attack</color> from the ally with the highest Attack.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\nこのスキルで会心が発生した場合、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000060_1_1]</color>の確率で、攻撃力が最も高い味方単体に<color=#28d9ed>連携</color>を発生させる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다.\n치명 공격 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000060_1_1]</color> 확률로 가장 공격력이 높은 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>협공</color>을 발생시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。\n发动暴击时，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000060_1_1]</color>的几率使攻击力最高的友军发动<color=#28d9ed>夹攻</color>。

desc.en: Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_1]</color> chance to grant all allies increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_1] turn(s)</color>, before attacking an enemy.\nWhen scoring a critical hit, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Silenced</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_1]</color>の確率で、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせた後、敵単体にダメージを与える。\nこのスキルで会心が発生した場合、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_2]</color>の確率で、対象に<color=#28d9ed>沈黙</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_1]턴</color> 동안 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>을 증가시킨 후 적을 공격합니다.\n치명 공격 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_2]턴</color> 동안 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>침묵</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_1]</color>的几率使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_1]回合</color>后，攻击敌人。 \n触发暴击时，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_2]</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>沉默</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_2]回合</color>。

desc.en:
Attacks all enemies. Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_2]</color> chance to inflict reduced <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_3_2] turn(s)</color>.
When scoring a critical hit on one or more enemies, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_1]</color> chance to increase the <color=#28d9ed>skill cooldowns</color> of all targets by <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.

When attacking an <color=#ffd732>Irregular Monster</color>, increases <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> of all allies by <color=#28d9ed>3%</color> (Max 5 stacks).
desc.jp:
敵全体にダメージを与える。<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_2]</color>の確率で、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_3_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
このスキルで会心が発生した場合、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_1]</color>の確率で、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>スキルターン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>UPさせる。

 <color=#ffd732>イレギュラーモンスター</color>を攻撃時、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>3%</color>UPさせる。(最大5回累積)
desc.kr:
적 전체를 공격합니다. <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_3_2]턴</color> 동안 대상 모두의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 감소시킵니다.
한 명 이상의 적에게 치명 공격 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_1]</color> 확률로 대상 모두의 <color=#28d9ed>스킬 쿨타임</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 증가시킵니다. 


<color=#ffd732>이레귤러 몬스터</color> 공격 시 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>3%</color> 증가시킵니다. (최대 5회 누적)
desc.zh:
攻击全体敌人。有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_2]</color>的几率使全体目标的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_3_2]回合</color>。
对1名以上的敌人触发暴击时，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_1]</color>的几率使全体目标的<color=#28d9ed>技能冷却时间</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

攻击<color=#ffd732>异型怪</color>时，使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>3%</color>(最多叠加5次)。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. After attacking, if the enemy has no <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color>, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_2]</color>. If the enemy has a <color=#28d9ed>buff</color>, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_1_1]</color> chance to remove <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>buff(s)</color> from the target.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、対象に<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>がない場合、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_2]</color>UPさせる。対象に<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>がある場合、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_1_1]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_1]個</color>解除する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. 공격 후 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>가 없다면 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_2]</color> 증가시킵니다. <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 보유하고 있다면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_1_1]</color> 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_1]개</color> 해제합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，若目标没有<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，则使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_2]</color>。若附带<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，则有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_1_1]</color>的几率解除目标的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_1]个</color><color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect) Decreases <color=#28d9ed>Damage Taken</color> by allies (excluding self) by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_5]</color> and further decreases <color=#28d9ed>Damage Taken</color> by Fire allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_6]</color>.\n\n(Triggered Effect) When an enemy uses a <color=#28d9ed>non-attack skill</color>, activates an <color=#28d9ed>Agile Response</color>. Reduces duration of buffs on all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>, increases <color=#28d9ed>Attack and Defense</color> of all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_2_2] turn(s)</color>, and increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_4]</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)自分を除く味方の<color=#28d9ed>受けるダメージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_5]</color>減少させ、火属性の味方の<color=#28d9ed>受けるダメージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_6]</color>追加で減少させる。\n\n(パッシブ効果)敵が<color=#28d9ed>攻撃以外のスキル</color>を使用時、<color=#28d9ed>【迅速対応】</color>を発動する。敵全体の強化効果持続時間を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>減少させ、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_2_2]ターン</color>の間UPさせた後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_4]</color>UPさせる。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과) 자신을 제외한 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>받는 피해</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_5]</color>만큼 감소시키고 화속성 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>받는 피해</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_6]</color>만큼 추가로 감소시킵니다.


(발동 효과) 적이 <color=#28d9ed>공격이 아닌 스킬</color> 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>신속 대응</color> 효과가 발동합니다.
적 전체의 강화 효과 지속 시간을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 감소시키고
아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_2_2]턴</color> 동안 증가시킨 뒤, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_4]</color>만큼 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果) 使除自身外的友军<color=#28d9ed>所受伤害</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_5]</color>，且使火属性友军的<color=#28d9ed>所受伤害</color>额外降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_6]</color>。\n\n(触发效果) 敌人使用<color=#28d9ed>非攻击类技能</color>时，触发<color=#28d9ed>迅速应对</color>效果。使全体敌人的强化效果持续时间减少<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>，并在使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>和<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_2_2]回合</color>后，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_4]</color>。

desc.en: Before using skill, removes <color=#28d9ed>1</color> buff from all enemies and attacks all enemies. Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_3_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unbuffable</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_3_1] turn(s)</color>. Enemy cannot Counterattack, Revenge, or use Agile Response immediately after this skill.
desc.jp: スキル使用前、敵全体の強化効果を<color=#28d9ed>1個</color>解除して敵全体にダメージを与える。対象全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_3_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>強化不可</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。このスキル直後には敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
desc.kr:
스킬 사용 전 적 전체의 강화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>1개</color> 해제하고
적 전체를 공격합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_3_1]</color> 확률로 대상 모두에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_3_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>강화 불가</color>를 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 施展技能前，解除全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>1个</color>强化效果并攻击全体敌人。有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_3_1]</color>的几率对所有目标造成<color=#28d9ed>无法强化</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_3_1]回合</color>。此技能施展后，不会触发敌人的反击、复仇及迅速应对。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_1_1]</color> chance to inflict reduced <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_1_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_1_1]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_1_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_1_1]</color>의 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_1_1]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
