desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_1_1]</color>的几率降低目标的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_1_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. After attacking, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color> chance to increase the duration of debuffs on the enemy by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1] turn(s)</color>, then inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color> on targets without debuffs for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color>の確率で敵の弱体効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1]ターン</color>の間増加させ、弱体効果がない対象の<color=#28d9ed>効果抵抗</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color>의 확률로 적이 보유한 약화 효과의 지속 시간을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1]턴</color> 증가시킨 후, 약화 효과가 없는 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>효과 저항</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color>的几率使敌人附带的弱化效果持续时间增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1]回合</color>，使未附带弱化效果目标的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_3_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unbuffable</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Defense</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_3_2] turn(s)</color>.\nRight after using this skill, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_3_1]</color> chance to avoid triggering an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_3_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>強化不可</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与し、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_3_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。\nこのスキルでは<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_3_1]</color>の確率で敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_3_2]</color>의 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_3_2]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>강화 불가</color>와 <color=#28d9ed>방어력 감소</color>를 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_3_1]</color>의 확률로 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_3_2]</color>的几率对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>无法强化</color>与<color=#28d9ed>防御力降低</color>效果，持续 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_3_2]回合</color>。\n此技能发动后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_3_1]</color>的几率不会触发敌人的反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。

desc.en:
Attacks an enemy.
Depending on the unique effect applied to the caster, activates one of the following effects:

Ume Ichirin: Attacks an enemy. Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000065_1_1]</color> chance to increase the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_1_1]</color> after attacking.

Sakura, Chiru: Attacks all enemies. Always attacks with <color=#28d9ed>elemental advantage</color>.
desc.jp:
敵単体にダメージを与える。
自分に【梅一輪】または【桜散る】がある場合、次の効果が発動する。

【梅一輪】：敵単体にダメージを与える。<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000065_1_1]</color>の確率で自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_1_1]</color>UPさせる。

 【桜散る】：敵全体 にダメージを与える。このスキルは敵の属性を無視し、<color=#28d9ed>有利属性</color>の攻撃判定でダメージを与える。
desc.kr:
적을 공격합니다.
보유한 고유 효과에 따라 이하의 효과 중 하나가 적용됩니다.

【우메이치린】 : 적을 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000065_1_1]</color>의 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_1_1]</color> 증가시킵니다.

【사쿠라치루】 : 적 전체를 공격합니다. 항상 <color=#28d9ed>유리한 상성</color>으로 적용됩니다.
desc.zh:
攻击敌人。
根据附带的固有效果触发以下效果之一。

【一朵梅花】：攻击敌人。攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000065_1_1]</color>的几率使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_1_1]</color>。

【樱花凋零】：攻击全体敌人。总是以<color=#28d9ed>优势属性</color>施展。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)Increases <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> by <color=#28d9ed>15%</color> and increases damage dealt to bosses.\nWhen using <color=#28d9ed>Mikazuki Form 1: Bloom</color>, increases WG damage dealt to enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_2_1]</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>上昇し、ボスへの与ダメージが増加する。\n<color=#28d9ed>ミカヅキ壱式：開花</color>使用時、敵へのWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_2_1]</color>増加する。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>15%</color> 증가하고, 보스에게 입히는 피해가 증가합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>미카즈키 1식 : 개화</color> 사용 시 적에게 입히는 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_2_1]</color> 증가합니다.
desc.zh: （被动效果）<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>，对首领怪物造成的伤害提高。\n使用<color=#28d9ed>三日月一式：开花</color>时，对敌方造成的WG伤害提高<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_2_1]</color>。

desc.en:
Attacks an enemy, then grants an extra turn.

Before attacking, if the target's Health is less than or equal to <color=#28d9ed>90%</color>, grants the <color=#28d9ed>Ume Ichirin</color> effect for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1] turn(s)</color> and increases damage dealt.

If the target's Health is greater than <color=#28d9ed>90%</color>, grants the <color=#28d9ed>Sakura, Chiru</color> effect for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2] turn(s)</color> and generates <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_3_4]</color> <color=#28d9ed>Chain Points</color>.
desc.jp:
敵単体にダメージを与え、追加ターンを獲得する。

攻撃前に対象の残りHPが<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>以下の場合、自分に<color=#28d9ed>【梅一輪】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与し、与えるダメージがUPする。

対象の残りHPが<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>を超える場合、自分に<color=#28d9ed>【桜散る】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与し、<color=#28d9ed>CP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_3_4]</color>獲得する。
desc.kr:
적을 공격 후 추가 턴을 획득합니다.

공격 전 대상의 현재 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>90%</color> 이하라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>우메이치린</color> 효과를 획득하고, 피해량이 증가합니다.

대상의 현재 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>90%</color>를 초과한다면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>사쿠라치루</color> 효과를 획득하고, <color=#28d9ed>CP</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_3_4]</color> 회복합니다.
desc.zh:
攻击敌人后获得额外回合。

攻击前，若目标的当前生命值在<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>以下，则获得<color=#28d9ed>一朵梅花</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1]回合</color>，并使伤害量
提升。

若目标的当前生命值高于<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>，则获得<color=#28d9ed>樱花凋零</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2]回合</color>，并恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_3_4]</color>点<color=#28d9ed>CP</color>。

desc.en:
Attacks an enemy and heals the ally with the lowest Health by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_1_1]</color>.
If the target is <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color>, activates Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、残りHPが最も低い味方単体のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_1_1]</color>回復する。\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>状態の場合、攻撃力が最も高い味方に連携を発生する。
desc.kr:
적을 공격하고 체력 상황이 가장 나쁜 아군의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_1_1]</color> 회복시킵니다.
대상이 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color> 상태라면 공격력이 가장 높은 아군의 협공을 발생시킵니다.
desc.zh:
攻击敌人，使生命值最低的友军恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_1_1]</color>的生命值。
若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>状态，触发攻击力最高的友军进行夹攻。

desc.en: (Triggered Effect) When hit, counterattacks with <color=#28d9ed>Venomous Charm</color>. Upon Counterattack, attacks all enemies and with a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000108_2_3]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Poison</color> on targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_2_3] turn(s)</color>.\nAfter the attack, heals <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_2_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>Health</color> of all allies and grant all allies a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_2_4] turn(s)</color>. The Barrier strength increases proportional to the target's Max Health.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)自分がダメージを受けた時、<color=#28d9ed>弱く致命的な者</color>として反撃する。反撃発動時に敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000108_2_3]</color>の確率で対象に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_2_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。\n攻撃後、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>HP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_2_1]</color>回復させ、味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_2_4]ターン</color>の間付与する。シールド量は対象の最大HPに応じてUPする。
desc.kr: (발동 효과) 자신이 피격 시 <color=#28d9ed>나약하고 치명적인 자</color>로 반격합니다. 반격 발동 시 적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000108_2_3]</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_2_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다.\n공격 후 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_2_1]</color>회복시키고 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_2_4]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 부여합니다. 실드량은 대상의 최대 체력에 비례하여 증가합니다.
desc.zh: （触发效果）自身受击时，以<color=#28d9ed>脆弱致命者</color>进行反击。触发反击时，攻击全体敌人，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000108_2_3]</color>概率对目标赋予<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_2_3]回合</color>。\n攻击后，使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_2_1]</color>，并对全体友军赋予<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_2_4]回合</color>。护盾值根据目标的生命值上限按比例提升。

desc.en: Dispels all debuffs from all allies and grants <color=#28d9ed>Immunity</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_3_2] turn(s)</color>. Then restores allies' Health by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_3_3]</color>. Also increases Earth allies' <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_3_4]</color>.
desc.jp: 味方全体のすべての弱体効果を解除し、<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。そして、味方全体のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_3_3]</color>回復する。さらに、地属性の味方の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_3_4]</color>UPさせる。
desc.kr: 아군 전체의 모든 약화 효과를 해제하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_3_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>면역</color>을 부여합니다. 그리고 아군 전체의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_3_3]</color> 회복시킵니다. 또한 지속성 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_3_4]</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 解除全体友军的所有弱化效果，并赋予<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000108_3_2]回合</color>。同时使全体友军的生命值恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_3_3]</color>。此外，使土属性友军的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000108_3_4]</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_1_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Bleed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_1_1] turns</color>.
desc.jp: 敵にダメージを与え。対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_1_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_1_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_1_1]</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_1_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_1_1]</color>的几率使目标陷入<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_1_1]</color>回合。

desc.en: Before attacking, increase all Water allies' <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_4] turn</color>, then attacks an enemy.\nAfter attacking, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_2_1]</color> chance to decrease the enemy's <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_1] turn(s)</color> and a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_2_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unhealable</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_2] turn(s)</color>.\nAdditionally increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000107_2_3]</color>.
desc.jp:
スキル使用前、水属性の味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_4]ターン</color>の間UPさせ、敵にダメージを与える。
攻撃後、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_2_1]</color>の確率で敵の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせ,
さらに<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_2_2]</color>の確率で、<color=#28d9ed>回復不可</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。
また、自分の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000107_2_3]</color>UPさせる。
desc.kr:
스킬 사용 전, 수속성 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_4]턴</color> 동안 증가시키고, 적을 공격합니다\n공격 후, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_2_1]</color> 확률로 적의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_1]턴</color> 동안 감소시키고\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_2_2]</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>회복 불가</color>를 부여합니다.
또한 자신의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000107_2_3]</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh:
在使用技能前，使全体水属性友军的<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_4]</color>回合，并攻击敌人。
攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_2_1]</color>的概率降低敌人的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_1]</color>回合；
并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_2_2]</color>的概率使目标陷入<color=#28d9ed>无法恢复</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_2_2]</color>回合。
此外，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000107_2_3]</color>。

name.en: Someday I Will Reach the Moon

desc.en:
Before attacking, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color> and decreases the target's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_1] turns</color>, then attacks the enemy.
After attacking, if the target's <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> is decreased, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_3_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Freeze</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Bleed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_2] turns</color>.
Damage dealt increases based on the number of <color=#28d9ed>Debuffs</color> on the target.
If the target is affected by <color=#28d9ed>Bleed</color>, performs an additional attack with <color=#28d9ed>Execution of Discipline</color>.
desc.jp:
スキル使用前、自分の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間UPし、対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせてから、敵にダメージを与える。
攻撃後, 対象の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>がDOWNしている場合、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_3_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>氷結</color>と<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。
さらに、対象の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>が多いほどダメージがUPする。
対象が<color=#28d9ed>出血</color＞状態の場合、<color=#28d9ed>規律執行</color>で追加攻撃を与える。
desc.kr:
스킬 사용 전, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 증가시키고 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_1]턴</color> 동안 감소시킨 뒤, 적을 공격합니다.
공격 후, 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>가 감소한 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_3_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 부여합니다.
대상에게 걸린 <color=#28d9ed>약화</color> 효과가 많을 수록 피해가 증가합니다.
대상이 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color> 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>규율 집행</color>으로 추가 공격합니다.
desc.zh:
在使用技能前，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>，并降低目标的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_1]</color>回合，然后攻击敌人。
攻击后，如果目标的<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>已被降低，则有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000107_3_2]</color>概率使其陷入<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>与<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000107_3_2]</color>回合。
目标身上的<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>越多，造成的伤害越高。
若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，则追加发动<color=#28d9ed>规律执行</color>攻击。

desc.en:
Attacks the enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000109_1_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Corrosive Poison</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000109_1_2]</color> turns.
If the target is a Boss, additionally inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Corrosive Poison</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000109_1_3]</color> turns before attacking.

This skill's damage increases proportional to the caster's Max Health instead of Attack.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000109_1_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>酸性の毒液</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000109_1_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。攻撃前、対象がボスモンスターの場合、<color=#28d9ed>酸性の毒液</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000109_1_3]ターン</color>の間追加で付与する。\n\nこのスキルは攻撃力の代わりに最大HPが高いほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr:
적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000109_1_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000109_1_2]턴</color> 동안 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>산성독</color>을 부여합니다.
대상이 보스라면 공격 전 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000109_1_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>산성독</color>을 추가 부여합니다.

이 스킬은 공격력 대신 최대 체력에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh:
攻击敌人，并以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000109_1_2]</color>的概率对目标施加<color=#28d9ed>酸性毒液</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000109_1_2]</color>回合。
若目标为<color=#28d9ed>首领怪物</color>，则在攻击前追加施加<color=#28d9ed>酸性毒液</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000109_1_3]</color>回合。

此技能的伤害会随着施术者的最大生命值提升而增加，而非基于攻击力。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect) The Poison inflicted by the caster is changed to <color=#28d9ed>Corrosive Poison</color>, and all attacks deal <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000109_2_4]</color> increased damage against enemies affected by it.

(Active Effect) Attacks the enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000109_2_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000109_2_1] turns</color>, then increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000109_2_3]</color>. desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 대상의 모든 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과 전이</color> 시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后将目标所有<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>进行<color=#28d9ed>强化效果转移</color>。

desc.en: If the caster has <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color>, Final DMG taken decreases by <color=#28d9ed>75%</color> and WG DMG taken decreases by <color=#28d9ed>100%</color>. DMG dealt increases by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> per buff held. (Max 100%)\n\nAt the start of battle, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>, <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color>, and <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_560] turns</color>.
desc.jp: 自分に<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>がある場合、受ける最終ダメージが<color=#28d9ed>75%</color>DOWNし、受けるWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>DOWNする。保有する<color=#28d9ed>強化効果1個</color>あたりダメージが<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>UPする。（最大100%）\n\n戦闘開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_560]ターン</color>の間UPする。
desc.kr:
자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>가 있으면 받는 최종 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>75%</color> 감소하고 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 감소합니다.
보유한 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color> 1개 마다 피해량이 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 증가합니다. (최대 100%)

전투 시작 시 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>,<color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>,<color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_560]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 自身拥有<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>时，受到的最终伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>75%</color>，每持有1个效果，伤害量提升<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。（最高100%）\n\n战斗开始时，使自身<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>、<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_event_monster_buff_560]回合</color>内提升。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Burned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>9 turns</color>.\nPrioritizes attacking enemies in the <color=#28d9ed>Front Row</color>.
desc.jp: 敵にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>9ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を付与する。\n<color=#28d9ed>前列</color>にいる敵を優先的に攻撃する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고, 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>9턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color>을 부여합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>전열</color>에 있는 적을 우선적으로 공격합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，对目标附加<color=#28d9ed>9回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>。\n优先攻击位于<color=#28d9ed>前排</color>的敌人。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Attack reduction</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.\nPrioritizes attacking enemies in the <color=#28d9ed>Front Row</color>.
desc.jp: 敵にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力DOWN</color>を付与する。\n<color=#28d9ed>前列</color>にいる敵を優先的に攻撃する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>공격력 감소</color>를 부여합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>전열</color>에 있는 적을 우선적으로 공격합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，使全体敌人附加<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力降低</color>。\n优先攻击位于<color=#28d9ed>前排</color>的敌人。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy.\nDMG decreases proportional to the number of debuffs the target holds, and prioritizes attacking enemies in the <color=#28d9ed>Front Row</color>.
desc.jp: 敵にダメージを与える。\n対象が保有する弱体効果の数に比例してダメージが減少し、<color=#28d9ed>前列</color>にいる敵を優先的に攻撃する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다.\n대상이 보유한 약화 효과 수량에 비례하여 피해가 감소하며 <color=#28d9ed>전열</color>에 있는 적을 우선적으로 공격합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。\n伤害按目标持有的弱化效果数量比例减少，并优先攻击位于<color=#28d9ed>前排</color>的敌人。

desc.en: DMG taken from enemies decreases.\nDMG taken increases proportional to the number of debuffs the enemy holds.
desc.jp: 敵から受けるダメージが減少する。\n敵が持つ弱体効果の数に比例して受けるダメージが増加する。
desc.kr: 적에게 받는 피해가 감소합니다.\n적이 가진 약화 효과 수량에 비례하여 받는 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 受到来自敌人的伤害减少。\n受到的伤害按敌人持有的弱化效果数量比例增加。

desc.en: If not at an elemental advantage, Final DMG taken and WG DMG decrease by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.
desc.jp: 有利属性でない場合、受ける最終ダメージとWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>減少する。
desc.kr: 유리한 속성이 아닐 경우 받는 최종 피해와 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 감소합니다.
desc.zh: 非克制属性时，受到的最终伤害和WG伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。
